units.rightText: And those that encamp on the east side toward the sunrising shall be they of the standard of the camp of Judah, according to their hosts: and the prince of the children of Judah shall be Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

units.leftText: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, even those who were counted of them were seven thousand five hundred.
units.rightText: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those that were numbered of them were seven thousand and five hundred.

units.leftText: The families of the Gershonites shall encamp behind the tabernacle westward.
units.rightText: The families of the Gershonites shall encamp behind the tabernacle westward.

units.leftText: Eliasaph the son of Lael shall be the prince of the fathers’ house of the Gershonites.
units.rightText: And the prince of the fathers’ house of the Gershonites shall be Eliasaph the son of Lael.

units.leftText: The duty of the sons of Gershon in the Tent of Meeting shall be the tabernacle, the tent, its covering, the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,
units.rightText: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tent of meeting shall be the tabernacle, and the Tent, the covering thereof, and the screen for the door of the tent of meeting,

units.leftText: the hangings of the court, the screen for the door of the court which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, and its cords for all of its service.
units.rightText: and the hangings of the court, and the screen for the door of the court, which is by the tabernacle, and by the altar round about, and the cords of it for all the service thereof.

units.leftText: Of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, the family of the Izharites, the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites. These are the families of the Kohathites.
units.rightText: And of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.

units.leftText: According to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, there were eight thousand six hundred keeping the requirements of the sanctuary.
units.rightText: According to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, there were eight thousand and six hundred, keeping the charge of the sanctuary.

units.leftText: The families of the sons of Kohath shall encamp on the south side of the tabernacle.
units.rightText: The families of the sons of Kohath shall encamp on the side of the tabernacle southward.

units.leftText: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
units.rightText: And the prince of the fathers’ house of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.

units.leftText: Their duty shall be the ark, the table, the lamp stand, the altars, the vessels of the sanctuary with which they minister, the screen, and all its service.
units.rightText: And their charge shall be the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary wherewith they minister, and the screen, and all the service thereof.

units.leftText: Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be prince of the princes of the Levites, with the oversight of those who keep the requirements of the sanctuary.
units.rightText: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be prince of the princes of the Levites, and have the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.

units.leftText: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites and the family of the Mushites. These are the families of Merari.
units.rightText: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these are the families of Merari.

units.leftText: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, were six thousand two hundred.
units.rightText: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand and two hundred.
leftNotes: 3:34 + 22,000 is the sum rounded to 2 significant digits. The sum of the Gershonites, Kohathites, and Merarites given above is 22,300, but the traditional Hebrew text has the number rounded to 2 significant digits, not 3 significant digits.

units.leftText: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail. They shall encamp on the north side of the tabernacle.
units.rightText: And the prince of the fathers’ house of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail: they shall encamp on the side of the tabernacle northward.

units.leftText: The appointed duty of the sons of Merari shall be the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets, all its instruments, all its service,
units.rightText: And the appointed charge of the sons of Merari shall be the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof, and all the instruments thereof, and all the service thereof,

units.leftText: the pillars of the court around it, their sockets, their pins, and their cords.
units.rightText: and the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords.

units.leftText: Those who encamp before the tabernacle eastward, in front of the Tent of Meeting toward the sunrise, shall be Moses, with Aaron and his sons, keeping the requirements of the sanctuary for the duty of the children of Israel. The outsider who comes near shall be put to death.
units.rightText: And those that encamp before the tabernacle eastward, before the tent of meeting toward the sunrising, shall be Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Israel; and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

units.leftText: All who were counted of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron counted at the commandment of the LORD, by their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty-two thousand.
units.rightText: All that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of Jehovah, by their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty and two thousand.

units.leftText: The LORD said to Moses, “Count all the firstborn males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.
units.rightText: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Number all the first-born males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.

units.leftText: You shall take the Levites for me—I am the LORD—instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the livestock of the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the livestock of the children of Israel.”
units.rightText: And thou shalt take the Levites for me (I am Jehovah) instead of all the first-born among the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the children of Israel.

units.leftText: Moses counted, as the LORD commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
units.rightText: And Moses numbered, as Jehovah commanded him, all the first-born among the children of Israel.

units.leftText: All the firstborn males according to the number of names from a month old and upward, of those who were counted of them, were twenty-two thousand two hundred seventy-three.
units.rightText: And all the first-born males according to the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those that were numbered of them, were twenty and two thousand two hundred and threescore and thirteen.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites instead of their livestock; and the Levites shall be mine. I am the LORD.
units.rightText: Take the Levites instead of all the first-born among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be mine: I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: For the redemption of the two hundred seventy-three of the firstborn of the children of Israel who exceed the number of the Levites,
units.rightText: And for the redemption of the two hundred and threescore and thirteen of the first-born of the children of Israel, that are over and above the number of the Levites,

units.leftText: you shall take five shekels apiece for each one; according to the shekel of the sanctuary you shall take them (the shekel is twenty gerahs );
units.rightText: thou shalt take five shekels apiece by the poll; after the shekel of the sanctuary shalt thou take them (the shekel is twenty gerahs):
leftNotes: 3:47 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces.
3:47 A gerah is about 0.5 grams or about 7.7 grains.

units.leftText: and you shall give the money, with which their remainder is redeemed, to Aaron and to his sons.”
units.rightText: and thou shalt give the money, wherewith the odd number of them is redeemed, unto Aaron and to his sons.

units.leftText: Moses took the redemption money from those who exceeded the number of those who were redeemed by the Levites;
units.rightText: And Moses took the redemption-money from them that were over and above them that were redeemed by the Levites;

units.leftText: from the firstborn of the children of Israel he took the money, one thousand three hundred sixty-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary;
units.rightText: from the first-born of the children of Israel took he the money, a thousand three hundred and threescore and five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
leftNotes: 3:50 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces, so 1365 shekels is about 13.65 kilograms or about 30 pounds.

units.leftText: and Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and to his sons, according to the LORD’s word, as the LORD commanded Moses.
units.rightText: and Moses gave the redemption-money unto Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of Jehovah, as Jehovah commanded Moses.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

units.leftText: “Take a census of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,
units.rightText: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,

units.leftText: from thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all who enter into the service to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.
units.rightText: from thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter upon the service, to do the work in the tent of meeting.

units.leftText: “This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting, regarding the most holy things.
units.rightText: This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the tent of meeting, about the most holy things:

units.leftText: When the camp moves forward, Aaron shall go in with his sons; and they shall take down the veil of the screen, cover the ark of the Testimony with it,
units.rightText: when the camp setteth forward, Aaron shall go in, and his sons, and they shall take down the veil of the screen, and cover the ark of the testimony with it,

units.leftText: put a covering of sealskin on it, spread a blue cloth over it, and put in its poles.
units.rightText: and shall put thereon a covering of sealskin, and shall spread over it a cloth all of blue, and shall put in the staves thereof.

units.leftText: “On the table of show bread they shall spread a blue cloth, and put on it the dishes, the spoons, the bowls, and the cups with which to pour out; and the continual bread shall be on it.
units.rightText: And upon the table of showbread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put thereon the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls and the cups wherewith to pour out; and the continual bread shall be thereon:

units.leftText: They shall spread on them a scarlet cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.
units.rightText: and they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in the staves thereof.

units.leftText: “They shall take a blue cloth and cover the lamp stand of the light, its lamps, its snuffers, its snuff dishes, and all its oil vessels, with which they minister to it.
units.rightText: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and its lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuffdishes, and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they minister unto it:

units.leftText: They shall put it and all its vessels within a covering of sealskin, and shall put it on the frame.
units.rightText: and they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of sealskin, and shall put it upon the frame.

units.leftText: “On the golden altar they shall spread a blue cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.
units.rightText: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in the staves thereof:

units.leftText: “They shall take all the vessels of ministry with which they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a blue cloth, cover them with a covering of sealskin, and shall put them on the frame.
units.rightText: and they shall take all the vessels of ministry, wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of sealskin, and shall put them on the frame.

units.leftText: “They shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth on it.
units.rightText: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth thereon:

units.leftText: They shall put on it all its vessels with which they minister about it, the fire pans, the meat hooks, the shovels, and the basins—all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread on it a covering of sealskin, and put in its poles.
units.rightText: and they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, wherewith they minister about it, the firepans, the flesh-hooks, and the shovels, and the basins, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of sealskin, and put in the staves thereof.

units.leftText: “When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the furniture of the sanctuary, as the camp moves forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to carry it; but they shall not touch the sanctuary, lest they die. The sons of Kohath shall carry these things belonging to the Tent of Meeting.
units.rightText: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the furniture of the sanctuary, as the camp is set forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it: but they shall not touch the sanctuary, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tent of meeting.

units.leftText: “The duty of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be the oil for the light, the sweet incense, the continual meal offering, and the anointing oil, the requirements of all the tabernacle, and of all that is in it, the sanctuary, and its furnishings.”
units.rightText: And the charge of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the continual meal-offering, and the anointing oil, the charge of all the tabernacle, and of all that therein is, the sanctuary, and the furniture thereof.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

units.leftText: “Don’t cut off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites;
units.rightText: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites;

units.leftText: but do this to them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in and appoint everyone to his service and to his burden;
units.rightText: but thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden;

units.leftText: but they shall not go in to see the sanctuary even for a moment, lest they die.”
units.rightText: but they shall not go in to see the sanctuary even for a moment, lest they die.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Take a census of the sons of Gershon also, by their fathers’ houses, by their families;
units.rightText: Take the sum of the sons of Gershon also, by their fathers’ houses, by their families;

units.leftText: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward until fifty years old: all who enter in to wait on the service, to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.
units.rightText: from thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to wait upon the service, to do the work in the tent of meeting.

units.leftText: “This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, in serving and in bearing burdens:
units.rightText: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, in serving and in bearing burdens:

units.leftText: they shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle and the Tent of Meeting, its covering, the covering of sealskin that is on it, the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,
units.rightText: they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tent of meeting, its covering, and the covering of sealskin that is above upon it, and the screen for the door of the tent of meeting,

units.leftText: the hangings of the court, the screen for the door of the gate of the court which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and whatever shall be done with them. They shall serve in there.
units.rightText: and the hangings of the court, and the screen for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and whatsoever shall be done with them: therein shall they serve.

units.leftText: At the commandment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burden and in all their service; and you shall appoint their duty to them in all their responsibilities.
units.rightText: At the commandment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burden, and in all their service; and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burden.

units.leftText: This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the Tent of Meeting. Their duty shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
units.rightText: This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the tent of meeting: and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

units.leftText: “As for the sons of Merari, you shall count them by their families, by their fathers’ houses;
units.rightText: As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them by their families, by their fathers’ houses;

units.leftText: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old—everyone who enters on the service, to do the work of the Tent of Meeting.
units.rightText: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them, every one that entereth upon the service, to do the work of the tent of meeting.

units.leftText: This is the duty of their burden, according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting: the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,
units.rightText: And this is the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tent of meeting: the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof,

units.leftText: the pillars of the court around it, their sockets, their pins, their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service. You shall appoint the instruments of the duty of their burden to them by name.
units.rightText: and the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name ye shall appoint the instruments of the charge of their burden.

units.leftText: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.”
units.rightText: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the tent of meeting, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

units.leftText: Moses and Aaron and the princes of the congregation counted the sons of the Kohathites by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,
units.rightText: And Moses and Aaron and the princes of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,

units.leftText: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting.
units.rightText: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entered upon the service, for work in the tent of meeting:

units.leftText: Those who were counted of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred fifty.
units.rightText: and those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.

units.leftText: These are those who were counted of the families of the Kohathites, all who served in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses.
units.rightText: These are they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all that did serve in the tent of meeting, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of Jehovah by Moses.

units.leftText: Those who were counted of the sons of Gershon, by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,
units.rightText: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon, their families, and by their fathers’ houses,

units.leftText: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old—everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting,
units.rightText: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entered upon the service, for work in the tent of meeting,

units.leftText: even those who were counted of them, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, were two thousand six hundred thirty.
units.rightText: even those that were numbered of them, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, were two thousand and six hundred and thirty.

units.leftText: These are those who were counted of the families of the sons of Gershon, all who served in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of the LORD.
units.rightText: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, all that did serve in the tent of meeting, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of Jehovah.

units.leftText: Those who were counted of the families of the sons of Merari, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,
units.rightText: And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,

units.leftText: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old—everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting,
units.rightText: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entered upon the service, for work in the tent of meeting,

units.leftText: even those who were counted of them by their families, were three thousand two hundred.
units.rightText: even those that were numbered of them by their families, were three thousand and two hundred.

units.leftText: These are those who were counted of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses.
units.rightText: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of Jehovah by Moses.

units.leftText: All those who were counted of the Levites whom Moses and Aaron and the princes of Israel counted, by their families and by their fathers’ houses,
units.rightText: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the princes of Israel numbered, by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,

units.leftText: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered in to do the work of service and the work of bearing burdens in the Tent of Meeting,
units.rightText: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entered in to do the work of service, and the work of bearing burdens in the tent of meeting,

units.leftText: even those who were counted of them, were eight thousand five hundred eighty.
units.rightText: even those that were numbered of them, were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore.

units.leftText: According to the commandment of the LORD they were counted by Moses, everyone according to his service and according to his burden. Thus they were counted by him, as the LORD commanded Moses.
units.rightText: According to the commandment of Jehovah they were numbered by Moses, every one according to his service, and according to his burden: thus were they numbered of him, as Jehovah commanded Moses.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Command the children of Israel that they put out of the camp every leper, everyone who has a discharge, and whoever is unclean by a corpse.
units.rightText: Command the children of Israel, that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that hath an issue, and whosoever is unclean by the dead:

units.leftText: You shall put both male and female outside of the camp so that they don’t defile their camp, in the midst of which I dwell.”
units.rightText: both male and female shall ye put out, without the camp shall ye put them; that they defile not their camp, in the midst whereof I dwell.

units.leftText: The children of Israel did so, and put them outside of the camp; as the LORD spoke to Moses, so the children of Israel did.
units.rightText: And the children of Israel did so, and put them out without the camp; as Jehovah spake unto Moses, so did the children of Israel.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Speak to the children of Israel: ‘When a man or woman commits any sin that men commit, so as to trespass against the LORD, and that soul is guilty,
units.rightText: Speak unto the children of Israel, When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, so as to trespass against Jehovah, and that soul shall be guilty;

units.leftText: then he shall confess his sin which he has done; and he shall make restitution for his guilt in full, add to it the fifth part of it, and give it to him in respect of whom he has been guilty.
units.rightText: then he shall confess his sin which he hath done: and he shall make restitution for his guilt in full, and add unto it the fifth part thereof, and give it unto him in respect of whom he hath been guilty.

units.leftText: But if the man has no kinsman to whom restitution may be made for the guilt, the restitution for guilt which is made to the LORD shall be the priest’s, in addition to the ram of the atonement, by which atonement shall be made for him.
units.rightText: But if the man have no kinsman to whom restitution may be made for the guilt, the restitution for guilt which is made unto Jehovah shall be the priest’s; besides the ram of the atonement, whereby atonement shall be made for him.

units.leftText: Every heave offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they present to the priest, shall be his.
units.rightText: And every heave-offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they present unto the priest, shall be his.

units.leftText: Every man’s holy things shall be his; whatever any man gives the priest, it shall be his.’”
units.rightText: And every man’s hallowed things shall be his: whatsoever any man giveth the priest, it shall be his.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them: ‘If any man’s wife goes astray and is unfaithful to him,
units.rightText: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man’s wife go aside, and commit a trespass against him,

units.leftText: and a man lies with her carnally, and it is hidden from the eyes of her husband and this is kept concealed, and she is defiled, there is no witness against her, and she isn’t taken in the act;
units.rightText: and a man lie with her carnally, and it be hid from the eyes of her husband, and be kept close, and she be defiled, and there be no witness against her, and she be not taken in the act;

units.leftText: and the spirit of jealousy comes on him, and he is jealous of his wife and she is defiled; or if the spirit of jealousy comes on him, and he is jealous of his wife and she isn’t defiled;
units.rightText: and the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be defiled: or if the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be not defiled:

units.leftText: then the man shall bring his wife to the priest, and shall bring her offering for her: one tenth of an ephah of barley meal. He shall pour no oil on it, nor put frankincense on it, for it is a meal offering of jealousy, a meal offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to memory.
units.rightText: then shall the man bring his wife unto the priest, and shall bring her oblation for her, the tenth part of an ephah of barley meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense thereon; for it is a meal-offering of jealousy, a meal-offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance.
leftNotes: 5:15 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel

units.leftText: The priest shall bring her near, and set her before the LORD.
units.rightText: And the priest shall bring her near, and set her before Jehovah:

units.leftText: The priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and the priest shall take some of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle and put it into the water.
units.rightText: and the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put it into the water.

units.leftText: The priest shall set the woman before the LORD, and let the hair of the woman’s head go loose, and put the meal offering of memorial in her hands, which is the meal offering of jealousy. The priest shall have in his hand the water of bitterness that brings a curse.
units.rightText: And the priest shall set the woman before Jehovah, and let the hair of the woman’s head go loose, and put the meal-offering of memorial in her hands, which is the meal-offering of jealousy: and the priest shall have in his hand the water of bitterness that causeth the curse.

units.leftText: The priest shall cause her to take an oath and shall tell the woman, “If no man has lain with you, and if you haven’t gone aside to uncleanness, being under your husband’s authority, be free from this water of bitterness that brings a curse.
units.rightText: And the priest shall cause her to swear, and shall say unto the woman, If no man have lain with thee, and if thou have not gone aside to uncleanness, being under thy husband, be thou free from this water of bitterness that causeth the curse.

units.leftText: But if you have gone astray, being under your husband’s authority, and if you are defiled, and some man has lain with you besides your husband—”

units.leftText: On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, prince of the children of Naphtali,
units.rightText: On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, prince of the children of Naphtali:

units.leftText: gave his offering:
units.rightText: his oblation was one silver platter, the weight whereof was a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meal-offering;

units.leftText: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;
units.rightText: one golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense;

units.leftText: one young bull,
units.rightText: one young bullock, one ram, one he-lamb a year old, for a burnt-offering;

units.leftText: one male goat for a sin offering;
units.rightText: one male of the goats for a sin-offering;

units.leftText: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Ahira the son of Enan.
units.rightText: and for the sacrifice of peace-offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five he-lambs a year old: this was the oblation of Ahira the son of Enan.

units.leftText: This was the dedication offering of the altar, on the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve silver platters, twelve silver bowls, twelve golden ladles;
units.rightText: This was the dedication of the altar, in the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve silver platters, twelve silver bowls, twelve golden spoons;

units.leftText: each silver platter weighing one hundred thirty shekels, and each bowl seventy; all the silver of the vessels two thousand four hundred shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary;
units.rightText: each silver platter weighing a hundred and thirty shekels, and each bowl seventy; all the silver of the vessels two thousand and four hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary;

units.leftText: the twelve golden ladles, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; all the gold of the ladles weighed one hundred twenty shekels;
units.rightText: the twelve golden spoons, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, after the shekel of the sanctuary; all the gold of the spoons a hundred and twenty shekels;

units.leftText: all the cattle for the burnt offering twelve bulls, the rams twelve, the male lambs a year old twelve, and their meal offering; and twelve male goats for a sin offering;
units.rightText: all the oxen for the burnt-offering twelve bullocks, the rams twelve, the he-lambs a year old twelve, and their meal-offering; and the males of the goats for a sin-offering twelve;

units.leftText: and all the cattle for the sacrifice of peace offerings: twenty-four bulls, sixty rams, sixty male goats, and sixty male lambs a year old. This was the dedication offering of the altar, after it was anointed.
units.rightText: and all the oxen for the sacrifice of peace-offerings twenty and four bullocks, the rams sixty, the he-goats sixty, the he-lambs a year old sixty. This was the dedication of the altar, after that it was anointed.

units.leftText: When Moses went into the Tent of Meeting to speak with the LORD, he heard his voice speaking to him from above the mercy seat that was on the ark of the Testimony, from between the two cherubim; and he spoke to him.
units.rightText: And when Moses went into the tent of meeting to speak with him, then he heard the Voice speaking unto him from above the mercy-seat that was upon the ark of the testimony, from between the two cherubim: and he spake unto him.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Speak to Aaron, and tell him, ‘When you light the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light in front of the lamp stand.’”
units.rightText: Speak unto Aaron, and say unto him, When thou lightest the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light in front of the candlestick.

units.leftText: Aaron did so. He lit its lamps to light the area in front of the lamp stand, as the LORD commanded Moses.
units.rightText: And Aaron did so; he lighted the lamps thereof so as to give light in front of the candlestick, as Jehovah commanded Moses.

units.leftText: This was the workmanship of the lamp stand, beaten work of gold. From its base to its flowers, it was beaten work. He made the lamp stand according to the pattern which the LORD had shown Moses.
units.rightText: And this was the work of the candlestick, beaten work of gold; unto the base thereof, and unto the flowers thereof, it was beaten work: according unto the pattern which Jehovah had showed Moses, so he made the candlestick.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.
units.rightText: Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.

units.leftText: You shall do this to them to cleanse them: sprinkle the water of cleansing on them, let them shave their whole bodies with a razor, let them wash their clothes, and cleanse themselves.
units.rightText: And thus shalt thou do unto them, to cleanse them: sprinkle the water of expiation upon them, and let them cause a razor to pass over all their flesh, and let them wash their clothes, and cleanse themselves.

units.leftText: Then let them take a young bull and its meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil; and another young bull you shall take for a sin offering.
units.rightText: Then let them take a young bullock, and its meal-offering, fine flour mingled with oil; and another young bullock shalt thou take for a sin-offering.

units.leftText: You shall present the Levites before the Tent of Meeting. You shall assemble the whole congregation of the children of Israel.
units.rightText: And thou shalt present the Levites before the tent of meeting: and thou shalt assemble the whole congregation of the children of Israel:

units.leftText: You shall present the Levites before the LORD. The children of Israel shall lay their hands on the Levites,
units.rightText: and thou shalt present the Levites before Jehovah. And the children of Israel shall lay their hands upon the Levites:

units.leftText: and Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD for a wave offering on the behalf of the children of Israel, that it may be theirs to do the service of the LORD.
units.rightText: and Aaron shall offer the Levites before Jehovah for a wave-offering, on the behalf of the children of Israel, that it may be theirs to do the service of Jehovah.

units.leftText: “The Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and you shall offer the one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering to the LORD, to make atonement for the Levites.
units.rightText: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bullocks: and offer thou the one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering, unto Jehovah, to make atonement for the Levites.

units.leftText: You shall set the Levites before Aaron and before his sons, and offer them as a wave offering to the LORD.
units.rightText: And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them for a wave-offering unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: Thus you shall separate the Levites from among the children of Israel, and the Levites shall be mine.
units.rightText: Thus shalt thou separate the Levites from among the children of Israel; and the Levites shall be mine.

units.leftText: “After that, the Levites shall go in to do the service of the Tent of Meeting. You shall cleanse them, and offer them as a wave offering.
units.rightText: And after that shall the Levites go in to do the service of the tent of meeting: and thou shalt cleanse them, and offer them for a wave-offering.

units.leftText: For they are wholly given to me from among the children of Israel; instead of all who open the womb, even the firstborn of all the children of Israel, I have taken them to me.
units.rightText: For they are wholly given unto me from among the children of Israel; instead of all that openeth the womb, even the first-born of all the children of Israel, have I taken them unto me.

units.leftText: For all the firstborn among the children of Israel are mine, both man and animal. On the day that I struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, I sanctified them for myself.
units.rightText: For all the first-born among the children of Israel are mine, both man and beast: on the day that I smote all the first-born in the land of Egypt I sanctified them for myself.

units.leftText: I have taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
units.rightText: And I have taken the Levites instead of all the first-born among the children of Israel.

units.leftText: I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the Tent of Meeting, and to make atonement for the children of Israel, so that there will be no plague among the children of Israel when the children of Israel come near to the sanctuary.”
units.rightText: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the tent of meeting, and to make atonement for the children of Israel; that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come nigh unto the sanctuary.

units.leftText: Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel did so to the Levites. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so the children of Israel did to them.
units.rightText: Thus did Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the Levites: according unto all that Jehovah commanded Moses touching the Levites, so did the children of Israel unto them.

units.leftText: The Levites purified themselves from sin, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them for a wave offering before the LORD and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.
units.rightText: And the Levites purified themselves from sin, and they washed their clothes: and Aaron offered them for a wave-offering before Jehovah; and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.

units.leftText: After that, the Levites went in to do their service in the Tent of Meeting before Aaron and before his sons: as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.
units.rightText: And after that went the Levites in to do their service in the tent of meeting before Aaron, and before his sons: as Jehovah had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did they unto them.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “This is what is assigned to the Levites: from twenty-five years old and upward they shall go in to wait on the service in the work of the Tent of Meeting;
units.rightText: This is that which belongeth unto the Levites: from twenty and five years old and upward they shall go in to wait upon the service in the work of the tent of meeting:

units.leftText: and from the age of fifty years they shall retire from doing the work, and shall serve no more,
units.rightText: and from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting upon the work, and shall serve no more,

units.leftText: but shall assist their brothers in the Tent of Meeting, to perform the duty, and shall perform no service. This is how you shall have the Levites do their duties.”
units.rightText: but shall minister with their brethren in the tent of meeting, to keep the charge, and shall do no service. Thus shalt thou do unto the Levites touching their charges.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

units.leftText: “Let the children of Israel keep the Passover in its appointed season.
units.rightText: Moreover let the children of Israel keep the passover in its appointed season.

units.leftText: On the fourteenth day of this month, at evening, you shall keep it in its appointed season. You shall keep it according to all its statutes and according to all its ordinances.”
units.rightText: In the fourteenth day of this month, at even, ye shall keep it in its appointed season: according to all the statutes of it, and according to all the ordinances thereof, shall ye keep it.

units.leftText: Moses told the children of Israel that they should keep the Passover.
units.rightText: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, that they should keep the passover.

units.leftText: They kept the Passover in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at evening, in the wilderness of Sinai. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did.
units.rightText: And they kept the passover in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, at even, in the wilderness of Sinai: according to all that Jehovah commanded Moses, so did the children of Israel.

units.leftText: There were certain men who were unclean because of the dead body of a man, so that they could not keep the Passover on that day, and they came before Moses and Aaron on that day.
units.rightText: And there were certain men, who were unclean by reason of the dead body of a man, so that they could not keep the passover on that day: and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day:

units.leftText: Those men said to him, “We are unclean because of the dead body of a man. Why are we kept back, that we may not offer the offering of the LORD in its appointed season among the children of Israel?”
units.rightText: and those men said unto him, We are unclean by reason of the dead body of a man: wherefore are we kept back, that we may not offer the oblation of Jehovah in its appointed season among the children of Israel?

units.leftText: Moses answered them, “Wait, that I may hear what the LORD will command concerning you.”
units.rightText: And Moses said unto them, Stay ye, that I may hear what Jehovah will command concerning you.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Say to the children of Israel, ‘If any man of you or of your generations is unclean by reason of a dead body, or is on a journey far away, he shall still keep the Passover to the LORD.
units.rightText: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If any man of you or of your generations shall be unclean by reason of a dead body, or be on a journey afar off, yet he shall keep the passover unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: In the second month, on the fourteenth day at evening they shall keep it; they shall eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
units.rightText: In the second month on the fourteenth day at even they shall keep it; they shall eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs:

units.leftText: They shall leave none of it until the morning, nor break a bone of it. According to all the statute of the Passover they shall keep it.
units.rightText: they shall leave none of it unto the morning, nor break a bone thereof: according to all the statute of the passover they shall keep it.

units.leftText: But the man who is clean, and is not on a journey, and fails to keep the Passover, that soul shall be cut off from his people. Because he didn’t offer the offering of the LORD in its appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.
units.rightText: But the man that is clean, and is not on a journey, and forbeareth to keep the passover, that soul shall be cut off from his people; because he offered not the oblation of Jehovah in its appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.

units.leftText: “‘If a foreigner lives among you and desires to keep the Passover to the LORD, then he shall do so according to the statute of the Passover, and according to its ordinance. You shall have one statute, both for the foreigner and for him who is born in the land.’”
units.rightText: And if a stranger shall sojourn among you, and will keep the passover unto Jehovah; according to the statute of the passover, and according to the ordinance thereof, so shall he do: ye shall have one statute, both for the sojourner, and for him that is born in the land.

units.leftText: On the day that the tabernacle was raised up, the cloud covered the tabernacle, even the Tent of the Testimony. At evening it was over the tabernacle, as it were the appearance of fire, until morning.
units.rightText: And on the day that the tabernacle was reared up the cloud covered the tabernacle, even the tent of the testimony: and at even it was upon the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire, until morning.

units.leftText: So it was continually. The cloud covered it, and the appearance of fire by night.
units.rightText: So it was alway: the cloud covered it, and the appearance of fire by night.

units.leftText: Whenever the cloud was taken up from over the Tent, then after that the children of Israel traveled; and in the place where the cloud remained, there the children of Israel encamped.
units.rightText: And whenever the cloud was taken up from over the Tent, then after that the children of Israel journeyed: and in the place where the cloud abode, there the children of Israel encamped.

units.leftText: At the commandment of the LORD, the children of Israel traveled, and at the commandment of the LORD they encamped. As long as the cloud remained on the tabernacle they remained encamped.
units.rightText: At the commandment of Jehovah the children of Israel journeyed, and at the commandment of Jehovah they encamped: as long as the cloud abode upon the tabernacle they remained encamped.

units.leftText: When the cloud stayed on the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the LORD’s command, and didn’t travel.
units.rightText: And when the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the charge of Jehovah, and journeyed not.

units.leftText: Sometimes the cloud was a few days on the tabernacle; then according to the commandment of the LORD they remained encamped, and according to the commandment of the LORD they traveled.
units.rightText: And sometimes the cloud was a few days upon the tabernacle; then according to the commandment of Jehovah they remained encamped, and according to the commandment of Jehovah they journeyed.

units.leftText: Sometimes the cloud was from evening until morning; and when the cloud was taken up in the morning, they traveled; or by day and by night, when the cloud was taken up, they traveled.
units.rightText: And sometimes the cloud was from evening until morning; and when the cloud was taken up in the morning, they journeyed: or if it continued by day and by night, when the cloud was taken up, they journeyed.

units.leftText: Whether it was two days, or a month, or a year that the cloud stayed on the tabernacle, remaining on it, the children of Israel remained encamped, and didn’t travel; but when it was taken up, they traveled.
units.rightText: Whether it were two days, or a month, or a year, that the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle, abiding thereon, the children of Israel remained encamped, and journeyed not; but when it was taken up, they journeyed.

units.leftText: At the commandment of the LORD they encamped, and at the commandment of the LORD they traveled. They kept the LORD’s command, at the commandment of the LORD by Moses.
units.rightText: At the commandment of Jehovah they encamped, and at the commandment of Jehovah they journeyed: they kept the charge of Jehovah, at the commandment of Jehovah by Moses.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Make two trumpets of silver. You shall make them of beaten work. You shall use them for the calling of the congregation and for the journeying of the camps.
units.rightText: Make thee two trumpets of silver; of beaten work shalt thou make them: and thou shalt use them for the calling of the congregation, and for the journeying of the camps.

units.leftText: When they blow them, all the congregation shall gather themselves to you at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
units.rightText: And when they shall blow them, all the congregation shall gather themselves unto thee at the door of the tent of meeting.

units.leftText: If they blow just one, then the princes, the heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves to you.
units.rightText: And if they blow but one, then the princes, the heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves unto thee.

units.leftText: When you blow an alarm, the camps that lie on the east side shall go forward.
units.rightText: And when ye blow an alarm, the camps that lie on the east side shall take their journey.

units.leftText: When you blow an alarm the second time, the camps that lie on the south side shall go forward. They shall blow an alarm for their journeys.
units.rightText: And when ye blow an alarm the second time, the camps that lie on the south side shall take their journey: they shall blow an alarm for their journeys.

units.leftText: But when the assembly is to be gathered together, you shall blow, but you shall not sound an alarm.
units.rightText: But when the assembly is to be gathered together, ye shall blow, but ye shall not sound an alarm.

units.leftText: “The sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets. This shall be to you for a statute forever throughout your generations.
units.rightText: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets; and they shall be to you for a statute for ever throughout your generations.

units.leftText: When you go to war in your land against the adversary who oppresses you, then you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets. Then you will be remembered before the LORD your God, and you will be saved from your enemies.
units.rightText: And when ye go to war in your land against the adversary that oppresseth you, then ye shall sound an alarm with the trumpets; and ye shall be remembered before Jehovah your God, and ye shall be saved from your enemies.

units.leftText: “Also in the day of your gladness, and in your set feasts, and in the beginnings of your months, you shall blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; and they shall be to you for a memorial before your God. I am the LORD your God.”
units.rightText: Also in the day of your gladness, and in your set feasts, and in the beginnings of your months, ye shall blow the trumpets over your burnt-offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace-offerings; and they shall be to you for a memorial before your God: I am Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: In the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day of the month, the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle of the covenant.
units.rightText: And it came to pass in the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day of the month, that the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle of the testimony.

units.leftText: The children of Israel went forward on their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud stayed in the wilderness of Paran.
units.rightText: And the children of Israel set forward according to their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud abode in the wilderness of Paran.

units.leftText: They first went forward according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses.
units.rightText: And they first took their journey according to the commandment of Jehovah by Moses.

units.leftText: First, the standard of the camp of the children of Judah went forward according to their armies. Nahshon the son of Amminadab was over his army.
units.rightText: And in the first place the standard of the camp of the children of Judah set forward according to their hosts: and over his host was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

units.leftText: Nethanel the son of Zuar was over the army of the tribe of the children of Issachar.
units.rightText: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Issachar was Nethanel the son of Zuar.

units.leftText: Eliab the son of Helon was over the army of the tribe of the children of Zebulun.
units.rightText: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.

units.leftText: The tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who bore the tabernacle, went forward.
units.rightText: And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who bare the tabernacle, set forward.

units.leftText: The standard of the camp of Reuben went forward according to their armies. Elizur the son of Shedeur was over his army.
units.rightText: And the standard of the camp of Reuben set forward according to their hosts: and over his host was Elizur the son of Shedeur.

units.leftText: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai was over the army of the tribe of the children of Simeon.
units.rightText: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

units.leftText: Eliasaph the son of Deuel was over the army of the tribe of the children of Gad.
units.rightText: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

units.leftText: The Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary. The others set up the tabernacle before they arrived.
units.rightText: And the Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary: and the others did set up the tabernacle against their coming.

units.leftText: The standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies. Elishama the son of Ammihud was over his army.
units.rightText: And the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their hosts: and over his host was Elishama the son of Ammihud.

units.leftText: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur was over the army of the tribe of the children of Manasseh.
units.rightText: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

units.leftText: Abidan the son of Gideoni was over the army of the tribe of the children of Benjamin.
units.rightText: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.

units.leftText: The standard of the camp of the children of Dan, which was the rear guard of all the camps, set forward according to their armies. Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai was over his army.
units.rightText: And the standard of the camp of the children of Dan, which was the rearward of all the camps, set forward according to their hosts: and over his host was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

units.leftText: Pagiel the son of Ochran was over the army of the tribe of the children of Asher.
units.rightText: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ochran.

units.leftText: Ahira the son of Enan was over the army of the tribe of the children of Naphtali.
units.rightText: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.

units.leftText: Thus were the travels of the children of Israel according to their armies; and they went forward.
units.rightText: Thus were the journeyings of the children of Israel according to their hosts; and they set forward.

units.leftText: Moses said to Hobab, the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses’ father-in-law, “We are journeying to the place of which the LORD said, ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us, and we will treat you well; for the LORD has spoken good concerning Israel.”
units.rightText: And Moses said unto Hobab, the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses’ father-in-law, We are journeying unto the place of which Jehovah said, I will give it you: come thou with us, and we will do thee good; for Jehovah hath spoken good concerning Israel.

units.leftText: He said to him, “I will not go; but I will depart to my own land, and to my relatives.”
units.rightText: And he said unto him, I will not go; but I will depart to mine own land, and to my kindred.

units.leftText: Moses said, “Don’t leave us, please; because you know how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and you can be our eyes.
units.rightText: And he said, Leave us not, I pray thee; forasmuch as thou knowest how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and thou shalt be to us instead of eyes.

units.leftText: It shall be, if you go with us—yes, it shall be—that whatever good the LORD does to us, we will do the same to you.”
units.rightText: And it shall be, if thou go with us, yea, it shall be, that what good soever Jehovah shall do unto us, the same will we do unto thee.

units.leftText: They set forward from the Mount of the LORD three days’ journey. The ark of the LORD’s covenant went before them three days’ journey, to seek out a resting place for them.
units.rightText: And they set forward from the mount of Jehovah three days’ journey; and the ark of the covenant of Jehovah went before them three days’ journey, to seek out a resting-place for them.

units.leftText: The cloud of the LORD was over them by day, when they set forward from the camp.
units.rightText: And the cloud of Jehovah was over them by day, when they set forward from the camp.

units.leftText: When the ark went forward, Moses said, “Rise up, LORD, and let your enemies be scattered! Let those who hate you flee before you!”
units.rightText: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, O Jehovah, and let thine enemies be scattered; and let them that hate thee flee before thee.

units.leftText: When it rested, he said, “Return, LORD, to the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel.”
units.rightText: And when it rested, he said, Return, O Jehovah, unto the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel.

units.leftText: The people were complaining in the ears of the LORD. When the LORD heard it, his anger burned; and the LORD’s fire burned among them, and consumed some of the outskirts of the camp.
units.rightText: And the people were as murmurers, speaking evil in the ears of Jehovah: and when Jehovah heard it, his anger was kindled; and the fire of Jehovah burnt among them, and devoured in the uttermost part of the camp.

units.leftText: The people cried to Moses; and Moses prayed to the LORD, and the fire abated.
units.rightText: And the people cried unto Moses; and Moses prayed unto Jehovah, and the fire abated.

units.leftText: The name of that place was called Taberah, because the LORD’s fire burned among them.
units.rightText: And the name of that place was called Taberah, because the fire of Jehovah burnt among them.
leftNotes: 11:3 Taberah means “burning”

units.leftText: The mixed multitude that was among them lusted exceedingly; and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, “Who will give us meat to eat?
units.rightText: And the mixed multitude that was among them lusted exceedingly: and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?

units.leftText: We remember the fish, which we ate in Egypt for nothing; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic;
units.rightText: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt for nought; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic:

units.leftText: but now we have lost our appetite. There is nothing at all except this manna to look at.”
units.rightText: but now our soul is dried away; there is nothing at all save this manna to look upon.

units.leftText: The manna was like coriander seed, and it looked like bdellium.
units.rightText: And the manna was like coriander seed, and the appearance thereof as the appearance of bdellium.
leftNotes: 11:7 Bdellium is a resin extracted from certain African trees.

units.leftText: The people went around, gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in mortars, and boiled it in pots, and made cakes of it. Its taste was like the taste of fresh oil.
units.rightText: The people went about, and gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in mortars, and boiled it in pots, and made cakes of it: and the taste of it was as the taste of fresh oil.

units.leftText: When the dew fell on the camp in the night, the manna fell on it.
units.rightText: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.

units.leftText: Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, every man at the door of his tent; and the LORD’s anger burned greatly; and Moses was displeased.
units.rightText: And Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, every man at the door of his tent: and the anger of Jehovah was kindled greatly; and Moses was displeased.

units.leftText: Moses said to the LORD, “Why have you treated your servant so badly? Why haven’t I found favor in your sight, that you lay the burden of all this people on me?
units.rightText: And Moses said unto Jehovah, Wherefore hast thou dealt ill with thy servant? and wherefore have I not found favor in thy sight, that thou layest the burden of all this people upon me?

units.leftText: Have I conceived all this people? Have I brought them out, that you should tell me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, as a nurse carries a nursing infant, to the land which you swore to their fathers’?
units.rightText: Have I conceived all this people? have I brought them forth, that thou shouldest say unto me, Carry them in thy bosom, as a nursing-father carrieth the sucking child, unto the land which thou swarest unto their fathers?

units.leftText: Where could I get meat to give all these people? For they weep before me, saying, ‘Give us meat, that we may eat.’
units.rightText: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people? for they weep unto me, saying, Give us flesh, that we may eat.

units.leftText: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.
units.rightText: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.

units.leftText: If you treat me this way, please kill me right now, if I have found favor in your sight; and don’t let me see my wretchedness.”
units.rightText: And if thou deal thus with me, kill me, I pray thee, out of hand, if I have found favor in thy sight; and let me not see my wretchedness.

units.leftText: The LORD said to Moses, “Gather to me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the elders of the people and officers over them; and bring them to the Tent of Meeting, that they may stand there with you.
units.rightText: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom thou knowest to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them unto the tent of meeting, that they may stand there with thee.

units.leftText: I will come down and talk with you there. I will take of the Spirit which is on you, and will put it on them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with you, that you don’t bear it yourself alone.
units.rightText: And I will come down and talk with thee there: and I will take of the Spirit which is upon thee, and will put it upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee, that thou bear it not thyself alone.

units.leftText: “Say to the people, ‘Sanctify yourselves in preparation for tomorrow, and you will eat meat; for you have wept in the ears of the LORD, saying, “Who will give us meat to eat? For it was well with us in Egypt.” Therefore the LORD will give you meat, and you will eat.
units.rightText: And say thou unto the people, Sanctify yourselves against to-morrow, and ye shall eat flesh; for ye have wept in the ears of Jehovah, saying, Who shall give us flesh to eat? for it was well with us in Egypt: therefore Jehovah will give you flesh, and ye shall eat.

units.leftText: You will not eat just one day, or two days, or five days, or ten days, or twenty days,
units.rightText: Ye shall not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days,

units.leftText: but a whole month, until it comes out at your nostrils, and it is loathsome to you; because you have rejected the LORD who is among you, and have wept before him, saying, “Why did we come out of Egypt?”’”
units.rightText: but a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you; because that ye have rejected Jehovah who is among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Egypt?

units.leftText: Moses said, “The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand men on foot; and you have said, ‘I will give them meat, that they may eat a whole month.’
units.rightText: And Moses said, The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand footmen; and thou hast said, I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.

units.leftText: Shall flocks and herds be slaughtered for them, to be sufficient for them? Shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to be sufficient for them?”
units.rightText: Shall flocks and herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?

units.leftText: The LORD said to Moses, “Has the LORD’s hand grown short? Now you will see whether my word will happen to you or not.”
units.rightText: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Is Jehovah’s hand waxed short? now shalt thou see whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.

units.leftText: Moses went out, and told the people the LORD’s words; and he gathered seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them around the Tent.
units.rightText: And Moses went out, and told the people the words of Jehovah: and he gathered seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the Tent.

units.leftText: The LORD came down in the cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the Spirit that was on him, and put it on the seventy elders. When the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied, but they did so no more.
units.rightText: And Jehovah came down in the cloud, and spake unto him, and took of the Spirit that was upon him, and put it upon the seventy elders: and it came to pass, that, when the Spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, but they did so no more.

units.leftText: But two men remained in the camp. The name of one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad; and the Spirit rested on them. They were of those who were written, but had not gone out to the Tent; and they prophesied in the camp.
units.rightText: But there remained two men in the camp, the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the Spirit rested upon them; and they were of them that were written, but had not gone out unto the Tent; and they prophesied in the camp.

units.leftText: A young man ran, and told Moses, and said, “Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp!”
units.rightText: And there ran a young man, and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp.

units.leftText: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his chosen men, answered, “My lord Moses, forbid them!”
units.rightText: And Joshua the son of Nun, the minister of Moses, one of his chosen men, answered and said, My lord Moses, forbid them.

units.leftText: Moses said to him, “Are you jealous for my sake? I wish that all the LORD’s people were prophets, that the LORD would put his Spirit on them!”
units.rightText: And Moses said unto him, Art thou jealous for my sake? would that all Jehovah’s people were prophets, that Jehovah would put his Spirit upon them!

units.leftText: Moses went into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.
units.rightText: And Moses gat him into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.

units.leftText: A wind from the LORD went out and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, about a day’s journey on this side, and a day’s journey on the other side, around the camp, and about two cubits above the surface of the earth.
units.rightText: And there went forth a wind from Jehovah, and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, about a day’s journey on this side, and a day’s journey on the other side, round about the camp, and about two cubits above the face of the earth.
leftNotes: 11:31 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters.

units.leftText: The people rose up all that day, and all of that night, and all the next day, and gathered the quails. He who gathered least gathered ten homers; and they spread them all out for themselves around the camp.
units.rightText: And the people rose up all that day, and all the night, and all the next day, and gathered the quails: he that gathered least gathered ten homers: and they spread them all abroad for themselves round about the camp.
leftNotes: 11:32 1 homer is about 220 liters or 6 bushels

units.leftText: While the meat was still between their teeth, before it was chewed, the LORD’s anger burned against the people, and the LORD struck the people with a very great plague.
units.rightText: While the flesh was yet between their teeth, ere it was chewed, the anger of Jehovah was kindled against the people, and Jehovah smote the people with a very great plague.

units.leftText: The name of that place was called Kibroth Hattaavah, because there they buried the people who lusted.
units.rightText: And the name of that place was called Kibroth-hattaavah, because there they buried the people that lusted.
leftNotes: 11:34 Kibroth Hattaavah means “graves of lust”

units.leftText: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth; and they stayed at Hazeroth.
units.rightText: From Kibroth-hattaavah the people journeyed unto Hazeroth; and they abode at Hazeroth.

units.leftText: Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married; for he had married a Cushite woman.
units.rightText: And Miriam and Aaron spake against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married; for he had married a Cushite woman.

units.leftText: They said, “Has the LORD indeed spoken only with Moses? Hasn’t he spoken also with us?” And the LORD heard it.
units.rightText: And they said, Hath Jehovah indeed spoken only with Moses? hath he not spoken also with us? And Jehovah heard it.

units.leftText: Now the man Moses was very humble, more than all the men who were on the surface of the earth.
units.rightText: Now the man Moses was very meek, above all the men that were upon the face of the earth.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke suddenly to Moses, to Aaron, and to Miriam, “You three come out to the Tent of Meeting!”
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake suddenly unto Moses, and unto Aaron, and unto Miriam, Come out ye three unto the tent of meeting. And they three came out.

units.leftText: The LORD came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forward.
units.rightText: And Jehovah came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forth.

units.leftText: He said, “Now hear my words. If there is a prophet among you, I, the LORD, will make myself known to him in a vision. I will speak with him in a dream.
units.rightText: And he said, Hear now my words: if there be a prophet among you, I Jehovah will make myself known unto him in a vision, I will speak with him in a dream.

units.leftText: My servant Moses is not so. He is faithful in all my house.
units.rightText: My servant Moses is not so; he is faithful in all my house:

units.leftText: With him, I will speak mouth to mouth, even plainly, and not in riddles; and he shall see the LORD’s form. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant, against Moses?”
units.rightText: with him will I speak mouth to mouth, even manifestly, and not in dark speeches; and the form of Jehovah shall he behold: wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant, against Moses?

units.leftText: The LORD’s anger burned against them; and he departed.
units.rightText: And the anger of Jehovah was kindled against them; and he departed.

units.leftText: The cloud departed from over the Tent; and behold, Miriam was leprous, as white as snow. Aaron looked at Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.
units.rightText: And the cloud removed from over the Tent; and, behold, Miriam was leprous, as white as snow: and Aaron looked upon Miriam, and, behold, she was leprous.

units.leftText: Aaron said to Moses, “Oh, my lord, please don’t count this sin against us, in which we have done foolishly, and in which we have sinned.
units.rightText: And Aaron said unto Moses, Oh, my lord, lay not, I pray thee, sin upon us, for that we have done foolishly, and for that we have sinned.

units.leftText: Let her not, I pray, be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.”
units.rightText: Let her not, I pray, be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he cometh out of his mother’s womb.

units.leftText: Moses cried to the LORD, saying, “Heal her, God, I beg you!”
units.rightText: And Moses cried unto Jehovah, saying, Heal her, O God, I beseech thee.

units.leftText: The LORD said to Moses, “If her father had but spit in her face, shouldn’t she be ashamed seven days? Let her be shut up outside of the camp seven days, and after that she shall be brought in again.”
units.rightText: And Jehovah said unto Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? let her be shut up without the camp seven days, and after that she shall be brought in again.

units.leftText: Miriam was shut up outside of the camp seven days, and the people didn’t travel until Miriam was brought in again.
units.rightText: And Miriam was shut up without the camp seven days: and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in again.

units.leftText: Afterward the people traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.
units.rightText: And afterward the people journeyed from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Send men, that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel. Of every tribe of their fathers, you shall send a man, every one a prince among them.”
units.rightText: Send thou men, that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a prince among them.
