units.leftText: Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran according to the commandment of the LORD. All of them were men who were heads of the children of Israel.
units.rightText: And Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran according to the commandment of Jehovah: all of them men who were heads of the children of Israel.

units.leftText: These were their names:
units.rightText: And these were their names: Of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.

units.leftText: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.
units.rightText: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.

units.leftText: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
units.rightText: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

units.leftText: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.
units.rightText: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.

units.leftText: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun.
units.rightText: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun.

units.leftText: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.
units.rightText: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.

units.leftText: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.
units.rightText: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.

units.leftText: Of the tribe of Joseph, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.
units.rightText: Of the tribe of Joseph, namely, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.

units.leftText: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.
units.rightText: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.

units.leftText: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.
units.rightText: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.

units.leftText: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.
units.rightText: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.

units.leftText: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
units.rightText: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

units.leftText: These are the names of the men who Moses sent to spy out the land. Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.
units.rightText: These are the names of the men that Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.

units.leftText: Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, “Go up this way by the South, and go up into the hill country.
units.rightText: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this way by the South, and go up into the hill-country:

units.leftText: See the land, what it is; and the people who dwell therein, whether they are strong or weak, whether they are few or many;
units.rightText: and see the land, what it is; and the people that dwell therein, whether they are strong or weak, whether they are few or many;

units.leftText: and what the land is that they dwell in, whether it is good or bad; and what cities they are that they dwell in, whether in camps, or in strongholds;
units.rightText: and what the land is that they dwell in, whether it is good or bad; and what cities they are that they dwell in, whether in camps, or in strongholds;

units.leftText: and what the land is, whether it is fertile or poor, whether there is wood therein, or not. Be courageous, and bring some of the fruit of the land.” Now the time was the time of the first-ripe grapes.
units.rightText: and what the land is, whether it is fat or lean, whether there is wood therein, or not. And be ye of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time was the time of the first-ripe grapes.

units.leftText: So they went up, and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, to the entrance of Hamath.
units.rightText: So they went up, and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, to the entrance of Hamath.

units.leftText: They went up by the South, and came to Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
units.rightText: And they went up by the South, and came unto Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

units.leftText: They came to the valley of Eshcol, and cut down from there a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bore it on a staff between two. They also brought some of the pomegranates and figs.
units.rightText: And they came unto the valley of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it upon a staff between two; they brought also of the pomegranates, and of the figs.

units.leftText: That place was called the valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the children of Israel cut down from there.
units.rightText: That place was called the valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the children of Israel cut down from thence.

units.leftText: They returned from spying out the land at the end of forty days.
units.rightText: And they returned from spying out the land at the end of forty days.

units.leftText: They went and came to Moses, to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, to the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word to them and to all the congregation. They showed them the fruit of the land.
units.rightText: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and showed them the fruit of the land.

units.leftText: They told him, and said, “We came to the land where you sent us. Surely it flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.
units.rightText: And they told him, and said, We came unto the land whither thou sentest us; and surely it floweth with milk and honey; and this is the fruit of it.

units.leftText: However, the people who dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified and very large. Moreover, we saw the children of Anak there.
units.rightText: Howbeit the people that dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified, and very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.

units.leftText: Amalek dwells in the land of the South. The Hittite, the Jebusite, and the Amorite dwell in the hill country. The Canaanite dwells by the sea, and along the side of the Jordan.”
units.rightText: Amalek dwelleth in the land of the South: and the Hittite, and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, dwell in the hill-country; and the Canaanite dwelleth by the sea, and along by the side of the Jordan.

units.leftText: Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, “Let’s go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it!”
units.rightText: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.

units.leftText: But the men who went up with him said, “We aren’t able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.”
units.rightText: But the men that went up with him said, We are not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.

units.leftText: They brought up an evil report of the land which they had spied out to the children of Israel, saying, “The land, through which we have gone to spy it out, is a land that eats up its inhabitants; and all the people who we saw in it are men of great stature.
units.rightText: And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had spied out unto the children of Israel, saying, The land, through which we have gone to spy it out, is a land that eateth up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it are men of great stature.

units.leftText: There we saw the Nephilim, the sons of Anak, who come from the Nephilim. We were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.”
units.rightText: And there we saw the Nephilim, the sons of Anak, who come of the Nephilim: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.
leftNotes: 13:33 or, giants
13:33 or, giants

units.leftText: All the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.
units.rightText: And all the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.

units.leftText: All the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron. The whole congregation said to them, “We wish that we had died in the land of Egypt, or that we had died in this wilderness!
units.rightText: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said unto them, Would that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would that we had died in this wilderness!

units.leftText: Why does the LORD bring us to this land, to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will be captured or killed! Wouldn’t it be better for us to return into Egypt?”
units.rightText: And wherefore doth Jehovah bring us unto this land, to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will be a prey: were it not better for us to return into Egypt?

units.leftText: They said to one another, “Let’s choose a leader, and let’s return into Egypt.”
units.rightText: And they said one to another, Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.

units.leftText: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.
units.rightText: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.

units.leftText: Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of those who spied out the land, tore their clothes.
units.rightText: And Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of them that spied out the land, rent their clothes:

units.leftText: They spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “The land, which we passed through to spy it out, is an exceedingly good land.
units.rightText: and they spake unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, The land, which we passed through to spy it out, is an exceeding good land.

units.leftText: If the LORD delights in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it to us: a land which flows with milk and honey.
units.rightText: If Jehovah delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it unto us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.

units.leftText: Only don’t rebel against the LORD, neither fear the people of the land; for they are bread for us. Their defense is removed from over them, and the LORD is with us. Don’t fear them.”
units.rightText: Only rebel not against Jehovah, neither fear ye the people of the land; for they are bread for us: their defence is removed from over them, and Jehovah is with us: fear them not.

units.leftText: But all the congregation threatened to stone them with stones.
units.rightText: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones. And the glory of Jehovah appeared in the tent of meeting unto all the children of Israel.

units.leftText: The LORD said to Moses, “How long will this people despise me? How long will they not believe in me, for all the signs which I have worked among them?
units.rightText: And Jehovah said unto Moses, How long will this people despise me? and how long will they not believe in me, for all the signs which I have wrought among them?

units.leftText: I will strike them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of you a nation greater and mightier than they.”
units.rightText: I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of thee a nation greater and mightier than they.

units.leftText: Moses said to the LORD, “Then the Egyptians will hear it; for you brought up this people in your might from among them.
units.rightText: And Moses said unto Jehovah, Then the Egyptians will hear it; for thou broughtest up this people in thy might from among them;

units.leftText: They will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that you LORD are among this people; for you LORD are seen face to face, and your cloud stands over them, and you go before them, in a pillar of cloud by day, and in a pillar of fire by night.
units.rightText: and they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that thou Jehovah art in the midst of this people; for thou Jehovah art seen face to face, and thy cloud standeth over them, and thou goest before them, in a pillar of cloud by day, and in a pillar of fire by night.

units.leftText: Now if you killed this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of you will speak, saying,
units.rightText: Now if thou shalt kill this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak, saying,

units.leftText: ‘Because the LORD was not able to bring this people into the land which he swore to them, therefore he has slain them in the wilderness.’
units.rightText: Because Jehovah was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness.

units.leftText: Now please let the power of the Lord be great, according as you have spoken, saying,
units.rightText: And now, I pray thee, let the power of the Lord be great, according as thou hast spoken, saying,
leftNotes: 14:17 The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.”

units.leftText: ‘The LORD is slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, forgiving iniquity and disobedience; and he will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation.’
units.rightText: Jehovah is slow to anger, and abundant in lovingkindness, forgiving iniquity and transgression; and that will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, upon the third and upon the fourth generation.

units.leftText: Please pardon the iniquity of this people according to the greatness of your loving kindness, and just as you have forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.”
units.rightText: Pardon, I pray thee, the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy lovingkindness, and according as thou hast forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.

units.leftText: The LORD said, “I have pardoned according to your word;
units.rightText: And Jehovah said, I have pardoned according to thy word:

units.leftText: but in very deed—as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with the LORD’s glory—
units.rightText: but in very deed, as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with the glory of Jehovah;

units.leftText: because all those men who have seen my glory and my signs, which I worked in Egypt and in the wilderness, yet have tempted me these ten times, and have not listened to my voice;
units.rightText: because all those men that have seen my glory, and my signs, which I wrought in Egypt and in the wilderness, yet have tempted me these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice;

units.leftText: surely they shall not see the land which I swore to their fathers, neither shall any of those who despised me see it.
units.rightText: surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that despised me see it:

units.leftText: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and has followed me fully, him I will bring into the land into which he went. His offspring shall possess it.
units.rightText: but my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.

units.leftText: Since the Amalekite and the Canaanite dwell in the valley, tomorrow turn and go into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”
units.rightText: Now the Amalekite and the Canaanite dwell in the valley: to-morrow turn ye, and get you into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

units.leftText: “How long shall I bear with this evil congregation that complain against me? I have heard the complaints of the children of Israel, which they complain against me.
units.rightText: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, that murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.

units.leftText: Tell them, ‘As I live, says the LORD, surely as you have spoken in my ears, so I will do to you.
units.rightText: Say unto them, As I live, saith Jehovah, surely as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you:

units.leftText: Your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness; and all who were counted of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, who have complained against me,
units.rightText: your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, that have murmured against me,

units.leftText: surely you shall not come into the land concerning which I swore that I would make you dwell therein, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
units.rightText: surely ye shall not come into the land, concerning which I sware that I would make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

units.leftText: But I will bring in your little ones that you said should be captured or killed, and they shall know the land which you have rejected.
units.rightText: But your little ones, that ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which ye have rejected.

units.leftText: But as for you, your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness.
units.rightText: But as for you, your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness.

units.leftText: Your children shall be wanderers in the wilderness forty years, and shall bear your prostitution, until your dead bodies are consumed in the wilderness.
units.rightText: And your children shall be wanderers in the wilderness forty years, and shall bear your whoredoms, until your dead bodies be consumed in the wilderness.

units.leftText: After the number of the days in which you spied out the land, even forty days, for every day a year, you will bear your iniquities, even forty years, and you will know my alienation.’
units.rightText: After the number of the days in which ye spied out the land, even forty days, for every day a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, even forty years, and ye shall know my alienation.

units.leftText: I, the LORD, have spoken. I will surely do this to all this evil congregation who are gathered together against me. In this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.”
units.rightText: I, Jehovah, have spoken, surely this will I do unto all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.

units.leftText: The men whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned and made all the congregation to murmur against him by bringing up an evil report against the land,
units.rightText: And the men, whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up an evil report against the land,

units.leftText: even those men who brought up an evil report of the land, died by the plague before the LORD.
units.rightText: even those men that did bring up an evil report of the land, died by the plague before Jehovah.

units.leftText: But Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh remained alive of those men who went to spy out the land.
units.rightText: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, remained alive of those men that went to spy out the land.

units.leftText: Moses told these words to all the children of Israel, and the people mourned greatly.
units.rightText: And Moses told these words unto all the children of Israel: and the people mourned greatly.

units.leftText: They rose up early in the morning and went up to the top of the mountain, saying, “Behold, we are here, and will go up to the place which the LORD has promised; for we have sinned.”
units.rightText: And they rose up early in the morning, and gat them up to the top of the mountain, saying, Lo, we are here, and will go up unto the place which Jehovah hath promised: for we have sinned.

units.leftText: Moses said, “Why now do you disobey the commandment of the LORD, since it shall not prosper?
units.rightText: And Moses said, Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of Jehovah, seeing it shall not prosper?

units.leftText: Don’t go up, for the LORD isn’t among you; that way you won’t be struck down before your enemies.
units.rightText: Go not up, for Jehovah is not among you; that ye be not smitten down before your enemies.

units.leftText: For there the Amalekite and the Canaanite are before you, and you will fall by the sword because you turned back from following the LORD; therefore the LORD will not be with you.”
units.rightText: For there the Amalekite and the Canaanite are before you, and ye shall fall by the sword: because ye are turned back from following Jehovah, therefore Jehovah will not be with you.

units.leftText: But they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain. Nevertheless, the ark of the LORD’s covenant and Moses didn’t depart out of the camp.
units.rightText: But they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, and Moses, departed not out of the camp.

units.leftText: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites who lived in that mountain, and struck them and beat them down even to Hormah.
units.rightText: Then the Amalekite came down, and the Canaanite who dwelt in that mountain, and smote them and beat them down, even unto Hormah.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land of your habitations, which I give to you,
units.rightText: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are come into the land of your habitations, which I give unto you,

units.leftText: and will make an offering by fire to the LORD—a burnt offering, or a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or as a free will offering, or in your set feasts, to make a pleasant aroma to the LORD, of the herd, or of the flock—
units.rightText: and will make an offering by fire unto Jehovah, a burnt-offering, or a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or as a freewill-offering, or in your set feasts, to make a sweet savor unto Jehovah, of the herd, or of the flock;

units.leftText: then he who offers his offering shall offer to the LORD a meal offering of one tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with one fourth of a hin of oil.
units.rightText: then shall he that offereth his oblation offer unto Jehovah a meal-offering of a tenth part of an ephah of fine flour mingled with the fourth part of a hin of oil:
leftNotes: 15:4 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel
15:4 A hin is about 6.5 liters or 1.7 gallons.

units.leftText: You shall prepare wine for the drink offering, one fourth of a hin, with the burnt offering or for the sacrifice, for each lamb.
units.rightText: and wine for the drink-offering, the fourth part of a hin, shalt thou prepare with the burnt-offering, or for the sacrifice, for each lamb.

units.leftText: “‘For a ram, you shall prepare for a meal offering two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the third part of a hin of oil;
units.rightText: Or for a ram, thou shalt prepare for a meal-offering two tenth parts of an ephah of fine flour mingled with the third part of a hin of oil:
leftNotes: 15:6 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel

units.leftText: and for the drink offering you shall offer the third part of a hin of wine, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
units.rightText: and for the drink-offering thou shalt offer the third part of a hin of wine, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: When you prepare a bull for a burnt offering or for a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or for peace offerings to the LORD,
units.rightText: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt-offering, or for a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or for peace-offerings unto Jehovah;

units.leftText: then he shall offer with the bull a meal offering of three tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with half a hin of oil;
units.rightText: then shall he offer with the bullock a meal-offering of three tenth parts of an ephah of fine flour mingled with half a hin of oil:
leftNotes: 15:9 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel

units.leftText: and you shall offer for the drink offering half a hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
units.rightText: and thou shalt offer for the drink-offering half a hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: Thus it shall be done for each bull, for each ram, for each of the male lambs, or of the young goats.
units.rightText: Thus shall it be done for each bullock, or for each ram, or for each of the he-lambs, or of the kids.

units.leftText: According to the number that you shall prepare, so you shall do to everyone according to their number.
units.rightText: According to the number that ye shall prepare, so shall ye do to every one according to their number.

units.leftText: “‘All who are native-born shall do these things in this way, in offering an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
units.rightText: All that are home-born shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you, or whoever may be among you throughout your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD, as you do, so he shall do.
units.rightText: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whosoever may be among you throughout your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah; as ye do, so he shall do.

units.leftText: For the assembly, there shall be one statute for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner, a statute forever throughout your generations. As you are, so the foreigner shall be before the LORD.
units.rightText: For the assembly, there shall be one statute for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you, a statute for ever throughout your generations: as ye are, so shall the sojourner be before Jehovah.

units.leftText: One law and one ordinance shall be for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner with you.’”
units.rightText: One law and one ordinance shall be for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land where I bring you,
units.rightText: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land whither I bring you,

units.leftText: then it shall be that when you eat of the bread of the land, you shall offer up a wave offering to the LORD.
units.rightText: then it shall be, that, when ye eat of the bread of the land, ye shall offer up a heave-offering unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: Of the first of your dough you shall offer up a cake for a wave offering. As the wave offering of the threshing floor, so you shall heave it.
units.rightText: Of the first of your dough ye shall offer up a cake for a heave-offering: as the heave-offering of the threshing-floor, so shall ye heave it.

units.leftText: Of the first of your dough, you shall give to the LORD a wave offering throughout your generations.
units.rightText: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto Jehovah a heave-offering throughout your generations.

units.leftText: “‘When you err, and don’t observe all these commandments which the LORD has spoken to Moses—
units.rightText: And when ye shall err, and not observe all these commandments, which Jehovah hath spoken unto Moses,

units.leftText: even all that the LORD has commanded you by Moses, from the day that the LORD gave commandment and onward throughout your generations—
units.rightText: even all that Jehovah hath commanded you by Moses, from the day that Jehovah gave commandment, and onward throughout your generations;

units.leftText: then it shall be, if it was done unwittingly, without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bull for a burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma to the LORD, with its meal offering and its drink offering, according to the ordinance, and one male goat for a sin offering.
units.rightText: then it shall be, if it be done unwittingly, without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt-offering, for a sweet savor unto Jehovah, with the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offering thereof, according to the ordinance, and one he-goat for a sin-offering.

units.leftText: The priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and they shall be forgiven; for it was an error, and they have brought their offering, an offering made by fire to the LORD, and their sin offering before the LORD, for their error.
units.rightText: And the priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and they shall be forgiven; for it was an error, and they have brought their oblation, an offering made by fire unto Jehovah, and their sin-offering before Jehovah, for their error:

units.leftText: All the congregation of the children of Israel shall be forgiven, as well as the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them; for with regard to all the people, it was done unwittingly.
units.rightText: and all the congregation of the children of Israel shall be forgiven, and the stranger that sojourneth among them; for in respect of all the people it was done unwittingly.

units.leftText: “‘If a person sins unwittingly, then he shall offer a female goat a year old for a sin offering.
units.rightText: And if one person sin unwittingly, then he shall offer a she-goat a year old for a sin-offering.

units.leftText: The priest shall make atonement for the soul who errs when he sins unwittingly before the LORD. He shall make atonement for him; and he shall be forgiven.
units.rightText: And the priest shall make atonement for the soul that erreth, when he sinneth unwittingly, before Jehovah, to make atonement for him; and he shall be forgiven.

units.leftText: You shall have one law for him who does anything unwittingly, for him who is native-born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them.
units.rightText: Ye shall have one law for him that doeth aught unwittingly, for him that is home-born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them.

units.leftText: “‘But the soul who does anything with a high hand, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, blasphemes the LORD. That soul shall be cut off from among his people.
units.rightText: But the soul that doeth aught with a high hand, whether he be home-born or a sojourner, the same blasphemeth Jehovah; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

units.leftText: Because he has despised the LORD’s word, and has broken his commandment, that soul shall be utterly cut off. His iniquity shall be on him.’”
units.rightText: Because he hath despised the word of Jehovah, and hath broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity shall be upon him.

units.leftText: While the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the Sabbath day.
units.rightText: And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks upon the sabbath day.

units.leftText: Those who found him gathering sticks brought him to Moses and Aaron, and to all the congregation.
units.rightText: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Moses and Aaron, and unto all the congregation.

units.leftText: They put him in custody, because it had not been declared what should be done to him.
units.rightText: And they put him in ward, because it had not been declared what should be done to him.

units.leftText: The LORD said to Moses, “The man shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall stone him with stones outside of the camp.”
units.rightText: And Jehovah said unto Moses, The man shall surely be put to death: all the congregation shall stone him with stones without the camp.

units.leftText: All the congregation brought him outside of the camp, and stoned him to death with stones, as the LORD commanded Moses.
units.rightText: And all the congregation brought him without the camp, and stoned him to death with stones; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them that they should make themselves fringes on the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put on the fringe of each border a cord of blue.
units.rightText: Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of each border a cord of blue:
leftNotes: 15:38 or, tassels (Hebrew צִיצִ֛ת)
15:38 or, tassel

units.leftText: It shall be to you for a fringe, that you may see it, and remember all the LORD’s commandments, and do them; and that you don’t follow your own heart and your own eyes, after which you used to play the prostitute;
units.rightText: and it shall be unto you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of Jehovah, and do them; and that ye follow not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to play the harlot;
leftNotes: 15:39 or, tassel

units.leftText: so that you may remember and do all my commandments, and be holy to your God.
units.rightText: that ye may remember and do all my commandments, and be holy unto your God.

units.leftText: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the LORD your God.”
units.rightText: I am Jehovah your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took some men.
units.rightText: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took men:

units.leftText: They rose up before Moses, with some of the children of Israel, two hundred fifty princes of the congregation, called to the assembly, men of renown.
units.rightText: and they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty princes of the congregation, called to the assembly, men of renown;

units.leftText: They assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said to them, “You take too much on yourself, since all the congregation are holy, everyone of them, and the LORD is among them! Why do you lift yourselves up above the LORD’s assembly?”
units.rightText: and they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said unto them, Ye take too much upon you, seeing all the congregation are holy, every one of them, and Jehovah is among them: wherefore then lift ye up yourselves above the assembly of Jehovah?

units.leftText: When Moses heard it, he fell on his face.
units.rightText: And when Moses heard it, he fell upon his face:

units.leftText: He said to Korah and to all his company, “In the morning, the LORD will show who are his, and who is holy, and will cause him to come near to him. Even him whom he shall choose, he will cause to come near to him.
units.rightText: and he spake unto Korah and unto all his company, saying, In the morning Jehovah will show who are his, and who is holy, and will cause him to come near unto him: even him whom he shall choose will he cause to come near unto him.

units.leftText: Do this: have Korah and all his company take censers,
units.rightText: This do: take you censers, Korah, and all his company;

units.leftText: put fire in them, and put incense on them before the LORD tomorrow. It shall be that the man whom the LORD chooses, he shall be holy. You have gone too far, you sons of Levi!”
units.rightText: and put fire in them, and put incense upon them before Jehovah to-morrow: and it shall be that the man whom Jehovah doth choose, he shall be holy: ye take too much upon you, ye sons of Levi.

units.leftText: Moses said to Korah, “Hear now, you sons of Levi!
units.rightText: And Moses said unto Korah, Hear now, ye sons of Levi:

units.leftText: Is it a small thing to you that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself, to do the service of the LORD’s tabernacle, and to stand before the congregation to minister to them;
units.rightText: seemeth it but a small thing unto you, that the God of Israel hath separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself, to do the service of the tabernacle of Jehovah, and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them;

units.leftText: and that he has brought you near, and all your brothers the sons of Levi with you? Do you seek the priesthood also?
units.rightText: and that he hath brought thee near, and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee? and seek ye the priesthood also?

units.leftText: Therefore you and all your company have gathered together against the LORD! What is Aaron that you complain against him?”
units.rightText: Therefore thou and all thy company are gathered together against Jehovah: and Aaron, what is he that ye murmur against him?

units.leftText: Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab; and they said, “We won’t come up!
units.rightText: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab; and they said, We will not come up:

units.leftText: Is it a small thing that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, but you must also make yourself a prince over us?
units.rightText: is it a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, but thou must needs make thyself also a prince over us?

units.leftText: Moreover you haven’t brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards. Will you put out the eyes of these men? We won’t come up.”
units.rightText: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: wilt thou put out the eyes of these men? we will not come up.

units.leftText: Moses was very angry, and said to the LORD, “Don’t respect their offering. I have not taken one donkey from them, neither have I hurt one of them.”
units.rightText: And Moses was very wroth, and said unto Jehovah, Respect not thou their offering: I have not taken one ass from them, neither have I hurt one of them.

units.leftText: Moses said to Korah, “You and all your company go before the LORD, you, and they, and Aaron, tomorrow.
units.rightText: And Moses said unto Korah, Be thou and all thy company before Jehovah, thou, and they, and Aaron, to-morrow:

units.leftText: Each man take his censer and put incense on it, and each man bring before the LORD his censer, two hundred fifty censers; you also, and Aaron, each with his censer.”
units.rightText: and take ye every man his censer, and put incense upon them, and bring ye before Jehovah every man his censer, two hundred and fifty censers; thou also, and Aaron, each his censer.

units.leftText: They each took his censer, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it, and stood at the door of the Tent of Meeting with Moses and Aaron.
units.rightText: And they took every man his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense thereon, and stood at the door of the tent of meeting with Moses and Aaron.

units.leftText: Korah assembled all the congregation opposite them to the door of the Tent of Meeting.
units.rightText: And Korah assembled all the congregation against them unto the door of the tent of meeting: and the glory of Jehovah appeared unto all the congregation.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

units.leftText: “Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!”
units.rightText: Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment.

units.leftText: They fell on their faces, and said, “God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and will you be angry with all the congregation?”
units.rightText: And they fell upon their faces, and said, O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and wilt thou be wroth with all the congregation?

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Speak to the congregation, saying, ‘Get away from around the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram!’”
units.rightText: Speak unto the congregation, saying, Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.

units.leftText: Moses rose up and went to Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.
units.rightText: And Moses rose up and went unto Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.

units.leftText: He spoke to the congregation, saying, “Depart, please, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest you be consumed in all their sins!”
units.rightText: And he spake unto the congregation, saying, Depart, I pray you, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest ye be consumed in all their sins.

units.leftText: So they went away from the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side. Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood at the door of their tents with their wives, their sons, and their little ones.
units.rightText: So they gat them up from the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood at the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little ones.

units.leftText: Moses said, “Hereby you shall know that the LORD has sent me to do all these works; for they are not from my own mind.
units.rightText: And Moses said, Hereby ye shall know that Jehovah hath sent me to do all these works; for I have not done them of mine own mind.

units.leftText: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they experience what all men experience, then the LORD hasn’t sent me.
units.rightText: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; then Jehovah hath not sent me.

units.leftText: But if the LORD makes a new thing, and the ground opens its mouth, and swallows them up with all that belong to them, and they go down alive into Sheol, then you shall understand that these men have despised the LORD.”
units.rightText: But if Jehovah make a new thing, and the ground open its mouth, and swallow them up, with all that appertain unto them, and they go down alive into Sheol; then ye shall understand that these men have despised Jehovah.
leftNotes: 16:30 Sheol is the place of the dead.

units.leftText: As he finished speaking all these words, the ground that was under them split apart.
units.rightText: And it came to pass, as he made an end of speaking all these words, that the ground clave asunder that was under them;

units.leftText: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up with their households, all of Korah’s men, and all their goods.
units.rightText: and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up, and their households, and all the men that appertained unto Korah, and all their goods.

units.leftText: So they, and all that belonged to them went down alive into Sheol. The earth closed on them, and they perished from among the assembly.
units.rightText: So they, and all that appertained to them, went down alive into Sheol: and the earth closed upon them, and they perished from among the assembly.
leftNotes: 16:33 Sheol is the place of the dead.

units.leftText: All Israel that were around them fled at their cry; for they said, “Lest the earth swallow us up!”
units.rightText: And all Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them; for they said, Lest the earth swallow us up.

units.leftText: Fire came out from the LORD, and devoured the two hundred fifty men who offered the incense.
units.rightText: And fire came forth from Jehovah, and devoured the two hundred and fifty men that offered the incense.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Speak to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter the fire away from the camp; for they are holy,
units.rightText: Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter thou the fire yonder; for they are holy,

units.leftText: even the censers of those who sinned against their own lives. Let them be beaten into plates for a covering of the altar, for they offered them before the LORD. Therefore they are holy. They shall be a sign to the children of Israel.”
units.rightText: even the censers of these sinners against their own lives; and let them be made beaten plates for a covering of the altar: for they offered them before Jehovah; therefore they are holy; and they shall be a sign unto the children of Israel.

units.leftText: Eleazar the priest took the bronze censers which those who were burned had offered; and they beat them out for a covering of the altar,
units.rightText: And Eleazar the priest took the brazen censers, which they that were burnt had offered; and they beat them out for a covering of the altar,

units.leftText: to be a memorial to the children of Israel, to the end that no stranger who isn’t of the offspring of Aaron, would come near to burn incense before the LORD, that he not be as Korah and as his company; as the LORD spoke to him by Moses.
units.rightText: to be a memorial unto the children of Israel, to the end that no stranger, that is not of the seed of Aaron, come near to burn incense before Jehovah; that he be not as Korah, and as his company: as Jehovah spake unto him by Moses.

units.leftText: But on the next day all the congregation of the children of Israel complained against Moses and against Aaron, saying, “You have killed the LORD’s people!”
units.rightText: But on the morrow all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, Ye have killed the people of Jehovah.

units.leftText: When the congregation was assembled against Moses and against Aaron, they looked toward the Tent of Meeting. Behold, the cloud covered it, and the LORD’s glory appeared.
units.rightText: And it came to pass, when the congregation was assembled against Moses and against Aaron, that they looked toward the tent of meeting: and, behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of Jehovah appeared.

units.leftText: Moses and Aaron came to the front of the Tent of Meeting.
units.rightText: And Moses and Aaron came to the front of the tent of meeting.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Get away from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!” They fell on their faces.
units.rightText: Get you up from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment. And they fell upon their faces.

units.leftText: Moses said to Aaron, “Take your censer, put fire from the altar in it, lay incense on it, carry it quickly to the congregation, and make atonement for them; for wrath has gone out from the LORD! The plague has begun.”
units.rightText: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take thy censer, and put fire therein from off the altar, and lay incense thereon, and carry it quickly unto the congregation, and make atonement for them: for there is wrath gone out from Jehovah; the plague is begun.

units.leftText: Aaron did as Moses said, and ran into the middle of the assembly. The plague had already begun among the people. He put on the incense, and made atonement for the people.
units.rightText: And Aaron took as Moses spake, and ran into the midst of the assembly; and, behold, the plague was begun among the people: and he put on the incense, and made atonement for the people.

units.leftText: He stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.
units.rightText: And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.

units.leftText: Now those who died by the plague were fourteen thousand seven hundred, in addition to those who died about the matter of Korah.
units.rightText: Now they that died by the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, besides them that died about the matter of Korah.

units.leftText: Aaron returned to Moses to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and the plague was stopped.
units.rightText: And Aaron returned unto Moses unto the door of the tent of meeting: and the plague was stayed.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Speak to the children of Israel, and take rods from them, one for each fathers’ house, of all their princes according to their fathers’ houses, twelve rods. Write each man’s name on his rod.
units.rightText: Speak unto the children of Israel, and take of them rods, one for each fathers’ house, of all their princes according to their fathers’ houses, twelve rods: write thou every man’s name upon his rod.

units.leftText: You shall write Aaron’s name on Levi’s rod. There shall be one rod for each head of their fathers’ houses.
units.rightText: And thou shalt write Aaron’s name upon the rod of Levi; for there shall be one rod for each head of their fathers’ houses.

units.leftText: You shall lay them up in the Tent of Meeting before the covenant, where I meet with you.
units.rightText: And thou shalt lay them up in the tent of meeting before the testimony, where I meet with you.

units.leftText: It shall happen that the rod of the man whom I shall choose shall bud. I will make the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against you, cease from me.”
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass, that the rod of the man whom I shall choose shall bud: and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against you.

units.leftText: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and all their princes gave him rods, for each prince one, according to their fathers’ houses, a total of twelve rods. Aaron’s rod was among their rods.
units.rightText: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel; and all their princes gave him rods, for each prince one, according to their fathers’ houses, even twelve rods: and the rod of Aaron was among their rods.

units.leftText: Moses laid up the rods before the LORD in the Tent of the Testimony.
units.rightText: And Moses laid up the rods before Jehovah in the tent of the testimony.

units.leftText: On the next day, Moses went into the Tent of the Testimony; and behold, Aaron’s rod for the house of Levi had sprouted, budded, produced blossoms, and bore ripe almonds.
units.rightText: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses went into the tent of the testimony; and, behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded, and put forth buds, and produced blossoms, and bare ripe almonds.

units.leftText: Moses brought out all the rods from before the LORD to all the children of Israel. They looked, and each man took his rod.
units.rightText: And Moses brought out all the rods from before Jehovah unto all the children of Israel: and they looked, and took every man his rod.

units.leftText: The LORD said to Moses, “Put back the rod of Aaron before the covenant, to be kept for a token against the children of rebellion; that you may make an end of their complaining against me, that they not die.”
units.rightText: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Put back the rod of Aaron before the testimony, to be kept for a token against the children of rebellion; that thou mayest make an end of their murmurings against me, that they die not.

units.leftText: Moses did so. As the LORD commanded him, so he did.
units.rightText: Thus did Moses: as Jehovah commanded him, so did he.

units.leftText: The children of Israel spoke to Moses, saying, “Behold, we perish! We are undone! We are all undone!
units.rightText: And the children of Israel spake unto Moses, saying, Behold, we perish, we are undone, we are all undone.

units.leftText: Everyone who keeps approaching the LORD’s tabernacle, dies! Will we all perish?”
units.rightText: Every one that cometh near, that cometh near unto the tabernacle of Jehovah, dieth: shall we perish all of us?

units.leftText: The LORD said to Aaron, “You and your sons and your fathers’ house with you shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary; and you and your sons with you shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.
units.rightText: And Jehovah said unto Aaron, Thou and thy sons and thy fathers’ house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary; and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.

units.leftText: Bring your brothers also, the tribe of Levi, the tribe of your father, near with you, that they may be joined to you, and minister to you; but you and your sons with you shall be before the Tent of the Testimony.
units.rightText: And thy brethren also, the tribe of Levi, the tribe of thy father, bring thou near with thee, that they may be joined unto thee, and minister unto thee: but thou and thy sons with thee shall be before the tent of the testimony.

units.leftText: They shall keep your commands and the duty of the whole Tent; only they shall not come near to the vessels of the sanctuary and to the altar, that they not die, neither they nor you.
units.rightText: And they shall keep thy charge, and the charge of all the Tent: only they shall not come nigh unto the vessels of the sanctuary and unto the altar, that they die not, neither they, nor ye.

units.leftText: They shall be joined to you and keep the responsibility of the Tent of Meeting, for all the service of the Tent. A stranger shall not come near to you.
units.rightText: And they shall be joined unto thee, and keep the charge of the tent of meeting, for all the service of the Tent: and a stranger shall not come nigh unto you.

units.leftText: “You shall perform the duty of the sanctuary and the duty of the altar, that there be no more wrath on the children of Israel.
units.rightText: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the altar; that there be wrath no more upon the children of Israel.

units.leftText: Behold, I myself have taken your brothers the Levites from among the children of Israel. They are a gift to you, dedicated to the LORD, to do the service of the Tent of Meeting.
units.rightText: And I, behold, I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel: to you they are a gift, given unto Jehovah, to do the service of the tent of meeting.

units.leftText: You and your sons with you shall keep your priesthood for everything of the altar, and for that within the veil. You shall serve. I give you the service of the priesthood as a gift. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”
units.rightText: And thou and thy sons with thee shall keep your priesthood for everything of the altar, and for that within the veil; and ye shall serve: I give you the priesthood as a service of gift: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Aaron, “Behold, I myself have given you the command of my wave offerings, even all the holy things of the children of Israel. I have given them to you by reason of the anointing, and to your sons, as a portion forever.
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Aaron, And I, behold, I have given thee the charge of my heave-offerings, even all the hallowed things of the children of Israel; unto thee have I given them by reason of the anointing, and to thy sons, as a portion for ever.

units.leftText: This shall be yours of the most holy things from the fire: every offering of theirs, even every meal offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall give to me, shall be most holy for you and for your sons.
units.rightText: This shall be thine of the most holy things, reserved from the fire: every oblation of theirs, even every meal-offering of theirs, and every sin-offering of theirs, and every trespass-offering of theirs, which they shall render unto me, shall be most holy for thee and for thy sons.

units.leftText: You shall eat of it like the most holy things. Every male shall eat of it. It shall be holy to you.
units.rightText: As the most holy things shalt thou eat thereof; every male shall eat thereof: it shall be holy unto thee.

units.leftText: “This is yours, too: the wave offering of their gift, even all the wave offerings of the children of Israel. I have given them to you, and to your sons and to your daughters with you, as a portion forever. Everyone who is clean in your house shall eat of it.
units.rightText: And this is thine: the heave-offering of their gift, even all the wave-offerings of the children of Israel; I have given them unto thee, and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee, as a portion for ever; every one that is clean in thy house shall eat thereof.

units.leftText: “I have given to you all the best of the oil, all the best of the vintage, and of the grain, the first fruits of them which they give to the LORD.
units.rightText: All the best of the oil, and all the best of the vintage, and of the grain, the first-fruits of them which they give unto Jehovah, to thee have I given them.

units.leftText: The first-ripe fruits of all that is in their land, which they bring to the LORD, shall be yours. Everyone who is clean in your house shall eat of it.
units.rightText: The first-ripe fruits of all that is in their land, which they bring unto Jehovah, shall be thine; every one that is clean in thy house shall eat thereof.

units.leftText: “Everything devoted in Israel shall be yours.
units.rightText: Everything devoted in Israel shall be thine.

units.leftText: Everything that opens the womb, of all flesh which they offer to the LORD, both of man and animal, shall be yours. Nevertheless, you shall surely redeem the firstborn of man, and you shall redeem the firstborn of unclean animals.
units.rightText: Everything that openeth the womb, of all flesh which they offer unto Jehovah, both of man and beast shall be thine: nevertheless the first-born of man shalt thou surely redeem, and the firstling of unclean beasts shalt thou redeem.

units.leftText: You shall redeem those who are to be redeemed of them from a month old, according to your estimation, for five shekels of money, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, which weighs twenty gerahs.
units.rightText: And those that are to be redeemed of them from a month old shalt thou redeem, according to thine estimation, for the money of five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary (the same is twenty gerahs).
leftNotes: 18:16 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces.
18:16 A gerah is about 0.5 grams or about 7.7 grains.

units.leftText: “But you shall not redeem the firstborn of a cow, or the firstborn of a sheep, or the firstborn of a goat. They are holy. You shall sprinkle their blood on the altar, and shall burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
units.rightText: But the firstling of a cow, or the firstling of a sheep, or the firstling of a goat, thou shalt not redeem; they are holy: thou shalt sprinkle their blood upon the altar, and shalt burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a sweet savor unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: Their meat shall be yours, as the wave offering breast and as the right thigh, it shall be yours.
units.rightText: And the flesh of them shall be thine, as the wave-breast and as the right thigh, it shall be thine.

units.leftText: All the wave offerings of the holy things which the children of Israel offer to the LORD, I have given you and your sons and your daughters with you, as a portion forever. It is a covenant of salt forever before the LORD to you and to your offspring with you.”
units.rightText: All the heave-offerings of the holy things, which the children of Israel offer unto Jehovah, have I given thee, and thy sons and thy daughters with thee, as a portion for ever: it is a covenant of salt for ever before Jehovah unto thee and to thy seed with thee.

units.leftText: The LORD said to Aaron, “You shall have no inheritance in their land, neither shall you have any portion among them. I am your portion and your inheritance among the children of Israel.
units.rightText: And Jehovah said unto Aaron, Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land, neither shalt thou have any portion among them: I am thy portion and thine inheritance among the children of Israel.

units.leftText: “To the children of Levi, behold, I have given all the tithe in Israel for an inheritance, in return for their service which they serve, even the service of the Tent of Meeting.
units.rightText: And unto the children of Levi, behold, I have given all the tithe in Israel for an inheritance, in return for their service which they serve, even the service of the tent of meeting.

units.leftText: Henceforth the children of Israel shall not come near the Tent of Meeting, lest they bear sin, and die.
units.rightText: And henceforth the children of Israel shall not come nigh the tent of meeting, lest they bear sin, and die.

units.leftText: But the Levites shall do the service of the Tent of Meeting, and they shall bear their iniquity. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations. Among the children of Israel, they shall have no inheritance.
units.rightText: But the Levites shall do the service of the tent of meeting, and they shall bear their iniquity: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations; and among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.

units.leftText: For the tithe of the children of Israel, which they offer as a wave offering to the LORD, I have given to the Levites for an inheritance. Therefore I have said to them, ‘Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.’”
units.rightText: For the tithe of the children of Israel, which they offer as a heave-offering unto Jehovah, I have given to the Levites for an inheritance: therefore I have said unto them, Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Moreover you shall speak to the Levites, and tell them, ‘When you take of the children of Israel the tithe which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then you shall offer up a wave offering of it for the LORD, a tithe of the tithe.
units.rightText: Moreover thou shalt speak unto the Levites, and say unto them, When ye take of the children of Israel the tithe which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then ye shall offer up a heave-offering of it for Jehovah, a tithe of the tithe.

units.leftText: Your wave offering shall be credited to you, as though it were the grain of the threshing floor, and as the fullness of the wine press.
units.rightText: And your heave-offering shall be reckoned unto you, as though it were the grain of the threshing-floor, and as the fulness of the winepress.

units.leftText: Thus you also shall offer a wave offering to the LORD of all your tithes, which you receive of the children of Israel; and of it you shall give the LORD’s wave offering to Aaron the priest.
units.rightText: Thus ye also shall offer a heave-offering unto Jehovah of all your tithes, which ye receive of the children of Israel; and thereof ye shall give Jehovah’s heave-offering to Aaron the priest.

units.leftText: Out of all your gifts, you shall offer every wave offering to the LORD, of all its best parts, even the holy part of it.’
units.rightText: Out of all your gifts ye shall offer every heave-offering of Jehovah, of all the best thereof, even the hallowed part thereof out of it.

units.leftText: “Therefore you shall tell them, ‘When you heave its best from it, then it shall be credited to the Levites as the increase of the threshing floor, and as the increase of the wine press.
units.rightText: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, When ye heave the best thereof from it, then it shall be reckoned unto the Levites as the increase of the threshing-floor, and as the increase of the winepress.

units.leftText: You may eat it anywhere, you and your households, for it is your reward in return for your service in the Tent of Meeting.
units.rightText: And ye shall eat it in every place, ye and your households: for it is your reward in return for your service in the tent of meeting.

units.leftText: You shall bear no sin by reason of it, when you have heaved from it its best. You shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, that you not die.’”
units.rightText: And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it, when ye have heaved from it the best thereof: and ye shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, that ye die not.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

units.leftText: “This is the statute of the law which the LORD has commanded. Tell the children of Israel to bring you a red heifer without spot, in which is no defect, and which was never yoked.
units.rightText: This is the statute of the law which Jehovah hath commanded, saying, Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring thee a red heifer without spot, wherein is no blemish, and upon which never came yoke.

units.leftText: You shall give her to Eleazar the priest, and he shall bring her outside of the camp, and one shall kill her before his face.
units.rightText: And ye shall give her unto Eleazar the priest, and he shall bring her forth without the camp, and one shall slay her before his face:

units.leftText: Eleazar the priest shall take some of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle her blood toward the front of the Tent of Meeting seven times.
units.rightText: and Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle her blood toward the front of the tent of meeting seven times.

units.leftText: One shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her meat, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn.
units.rightText: And one shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn:

units.leftText: The priest shall take cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the middle of the burning of the heifer.
units.rightText: and the priest shall take cedar-wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the midst of the burning of the heifer.

units.leftText: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the evening.
units.rightText: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the even.

units.leftText: He who burns her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the evening.
units.rightText: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the even.

units.leftText: “A man who is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up outside of the camp in a clean place; and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for use in water for cleansing impurity. It is a sin offering.
units.rightText: And a man that is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up without the camp in a clean place; and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for a water for impurity: it is a sin-offering.

units.leftText: He who gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. It shall be to the children of Israel, and to the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them, for a statute forever.
units.rightText: And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: and it shall be unto the children of Israel, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them, for a statute for ever.

units.leftText: “He who touches the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.
units.rightText: He that toucheth the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days:

units.leftText: He shall purify himself with water on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean; but if he doesn’t purify himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.
units.rightText: the same shall purify himself therewith on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean: but if he purify not himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.

units.leftText: Whoever touches a dead person, the body of a man who has died, and doesn’t purify himself, defiles the LORD’s tabernacle; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel; because the water for impurity was not sprinkled on him, he shall be unclean. His uncleanness is yet on him.
units.rightText: Whosoever toucheth a dead person, the body of a man that hath died, and purifieth not himself, defileth the tabernacle of Jehovah; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel: because the water for impurity was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is yet upon him.

units.leftText: “This is the law when a man dies in a tent: everyone who comes into the tent, and everyone who is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.
units.rightText: This is the law when a man dieth in a tent: every one that cometh into the tent, and every one that is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.

units.leftText: Every open vessel, which has no covering bound on it, is unclean.
units.rightText: And every open vessel, which hath no covering bound upon it, is unclean.

units.leftText: “Whoever in the open field touches one who is slain with a sword, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
units.rightText: And whosoever in the open field toucheth one that is slain with a sword, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.

units.leftText: “For the unclean, they shall take of the ashes of the burning of the sin offering; and running water shall be poured on them in a vessel.
units.rightText: And for the unclean they shall take of the ashes of the burning of the sin-offering; and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel:

units.leftText: A clean person shall take hyssop, dip it in the water, and sprinkle it on the tent, on all the vessels, on the persons who were there, and on him who touched the bone, or the slain, or the dead, or the grave.
units.rightText: and a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip it in the water, and sprinkle it upon the tent, and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched the bone, or the slain, or the dead, or the grave:

units.leftText: The clean person shall sprinkle on the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day. On the seventh day, he shall purify him. He shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at evening.
units.rightText: and the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify him; and he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at even.

units.leftText: But the man who shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the assembly, because he has defiled the sanctuary of the LORD. The water for impurity has not been sprinkled on him. He is unclean.
units.rightText: But the man that shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from the midst of the assembly, because he hath defiled the sanctuary of Jehovah: the water for impurity hath not been sprinkled upon him; he is unclean.

units.leftText: It shall be a perpetual statute to them. He who sprinkles the water for impurity shall wash his clothes, and he who touches the water for impurity shall be unclean until evening.
units.rightText: And it shall be a perpetual statute unto them: and he that sprinkleth the water for impurity shall wash his clothes, and he that toucheth the water for impurity shall be unclean until even.

units.leftText: “Whatever the unclean person touches shall be unclean; and the soul that touches it shall be unclean until evening.”
units.rightText: And whatsoever the unclean person toucheth shall be unclean; and the soul that toucheth it shall be unclean until even.

units.leftText: The children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month. The people stayed in Kadesh. Miriam died there, and was buried there.
units.rightText: And the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month: and the people abode in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.

units.leftText: There was no water for the congregation; and they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.
units.rightText: And there was no water for the congregation: and they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.

units.leftText: The people quarreled with Moses, and spoke, saying, “We wish that we had died when our brothers died before the LORD!
units.rightText: And the people strove with Moses, and spake, saying, Would that we had died when our brethren died before Jehovah!

units.leftText: Why have you brought the LORD’s assembly into this wilderness, that we should die there, we and our animals?
units.rightText: And why have ye brought the assembly of Jehovah into this wilderness, that we should die there, we and our beasts?

units.leftText: Why have you made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in to this evil place? It is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.”
units.rightText: And wherefore have ye made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in unto this evil place? it is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.

units.leftText: Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and fell on their faces. The LORD’s glory appeared to them.
units.rightText: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tent of meeting, and fell upon their faces: and the glory of Jehovah appeared unto them.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Take the rod, and assemble the congregation, you, and Aaron your brother, and speak to the rock before their eyes, that it pour out its water. You shall bring water to them out of the rock; so you shall give the congregation and their livestock drink.”
units.rightText: Take the rod, and assemble the congregation, thou, and Aaron thy brother, and speak ye unto the rock before their eyes, that it give forth its water; and thou shalt bring forth to them water out of the rock; so thou shalt give the congregation and their cattle drink.

units.leftText: Moses took the rod from before the LORD, as he commanded him.
units.rightText: And Moses took the rod from before Jehovah, as he commanded him.
