units.leftText: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance,
units.rightText: their meal-offering and their drink-offerings for the bullock, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance:

units.leftText: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering, and its drink offering.
units.rightText: and one he-goat for a sin-offering; besides the continual burnt-offering, and the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offering thereof.

units.leftText: “‘You shall offer these to the LORD in your set feasts—in addition to your vows and your free will offerings—for your burnt offerings, your meal offerings, your drink offerings, and your peace offerings.’”
units.rightText: These ye shall offer unto Jehovah in your set feasts, besides your vows, and your freewill-offerings, for your burnt-offerings, and for your meal-offerings, and for your drink-offerings, and for your peace-offerings.

units.leftText: Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the LORD commanded Moses.
units.rightText: And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that Jehovah commanded Moses.

units.leftText: Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which the LORD has commanded.
units.rightText: And Moses spake unto the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which Jehovah hath commanded.

units.leftText: When a man vows a vow to the LORD, or swears an oath to bind his soul with a bond, he shall not break his word. He shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.
units.rightText: When a man voweth a vow unto Jehovah, or sweareth an oath to bind his soul with a bond, he shall not break his word; he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth.

units.leftText: “Also, when a woman vows a vow to the LORD and binds herself by a pledge, being in her father’s house, in her youth,
units.rightText: Also when a woman voweth a vow unto Jehovah, and bindeth herself by a bond, being in her father’s house, in her youth,

units.leftText: and her father hears her vow and her pledge with which she has bound her soul, and her father says nothing to her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she has bound her soul shall stand.
units.rightText: and her father heareth her vow, and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul, and her father holdeth his peace at her; then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand.

units.leftText: But if her father forbids her in the day that he hears, none of her vows or of her pledges with which she has bound her soul, shall stand. The LORD will forgive her, because her father has forbidden her.
units.rightText: But if her father disallow her in the day that he heareth, none of her vows, or of her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand: and Jehovah will forgive her, because her father disallowed her.

units.leftText: “If she has a husband, while her vows are on her, or the rash utterance of her lips with which she has bound her soul,
units.rightText: And if she be married to a husband, while her vows are upon her, or the rash utterance of her lips, wherewith she hath bound her soul,

units.leftText: and her husband hears it, and says nothing to her in the day that he hears it; then her vows shall stand, and her pledges with which she has bound her soul shall stand.
units.rightText: and her husband hear it, and hold his peace at her in the day that he heareth it; then her vows shall stand, and her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand.

units.leftText: But if her husband forbids her in the day that he hears it, then he makes void her vow which is on her and the rash utterance of her lips, with which she has bound her soul. The LORD will forgive her.
units.rightText: But if her husband disallow her in the day that he heareth it, then he shall make void her vow which is upon her, and the rash utterance of her lips, wherewith she hath bound her soul: and Jehovah will forgive her.

units.leftText: “But the vow of a widow, or of her who is divorced, everything with which she has bound her soul shall stand against her.
units.rightText: But the vow of a widow, or of her that is divorced, even everything wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand against her.

units.leftText: “If she vowed in her husband’s house or bound her soul by a bond with an oath,
units.rightText: And if she vowed in her husband’s house, or bound her soul by a bond with an oath,

units.leftText: and her husband heard it, and held his peace at her and didn’t disallow her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she bound her soul shall stand.
units.rightText: and her husband heard it, and held his peace at her, and disallowed her not; then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.

units.leftText: But if her husband made them null and void in the day that he heard them, then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand. Her husband has made them void. The LORD will forgive her.
units.rightText: But if her husband made them null and void in the day that he heard them, then whatsoever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand: her husband hath made them void; and Jehovah will forgive her.

units.leftText: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.
units.rightText: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.

units.leftText: But if her husband says nothing to her from day to day, then he establishes all her vows or all her pledges which are on her. He has established them, because he said nothing to her in the day that he heard them.
units.rightText: But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day, then he establisheth all her vows, or all her bonds, which are upon her: he hath established them, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them.

units.leftText: But if he makes them null and void after he has heard them, then he shall bear her iniquity.”
units.rightText: But if he shall make them null and void after that he hath heard them, then he shall bear her iniquity.

units.leftText: These are the statutes which the LORD commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, being in her youth, in her father’s house.
units.rightText: These are the statutes, which Jehovah commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, being in her youth, in her father’s house.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Avenge the children of Israel on the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people.”
units.rightText: Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites: afterward shalt thou be gathered unto thy people.

units.leftText: Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Arm men from among you for war, that they may go against Midian, to execute the LORD’s vengeance on Midian.
units.rightText: And Moses spake unto the people, saying, Arm ye men from among you for the war, that they may go against Midian, to execute Jehovah’s vengeance on Midian.

units.leftText: You shall send one thousand out of every tribe, throughout all the tribes of Israel, to the war.”
units.rightText: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war.

units.leftText: So there were delivered, out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand from every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
units.rightText: So there were delivered, out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.

units.leftText: Moses sent them, one thousand of every tribe, to the war with Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.
units.rightText: And Moses sent them, a thousand of every tribe, to the war, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.

units.leftText: They fought against Midian, as the LORD commanded Moses. They killed every male.
units.rightText: And they warred against Midian, as Jehovah commanded Moses; and they slew every male.

units.leftText: They killed the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam the son of Beor with the sword.
units.rightText: And they slew the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.

units.leftText: The children of Israel took the women of Midian captive with their little ones; and all their livestock, all their flocks, and all their goods, they took as plunder.
units.rightText: And the children of Israel took captive the women of Midian and their little ones; and all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods, they took for a prey.

units.leftText: All their cities in the places in which they lived, and all their encampments, they burned with fire.
units.rightText: And all their cities in the places wherein they dwelt, and all their encampments, they burnt with fire.

units.leftText: They took all the captives, and all the plunder, both of man and of animal.
units.rightText: And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, both of man and of beast.

units.leftText: They brought the captives with the prey and the plunder, to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.
units.rightText: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, unto Moses, and unto Eleazar the priest, and unto the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.

units.leftText: Moses and Eleazar the priest, with all the princes of the congregation, went out to meet them outside of the camp.
units.rightText: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them without the camp.

units.leftText: Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.
units.rightText: And Moses was wroth with the officers of the host, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.

units.leftText: Moses said to them, “Have you saved all the women alive?
units.rightText: And Moses said unto them, Have ye saved all the women alive?

units.leftText: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the LORD in the matter of Peor, and so the plague was among the congregation of the LORD.
units.rightText: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against Jehovah in the matter of Peor, and so the plague was among the congregation of Jehovah.

units.leftText: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known man by lying with him.
units.rightText: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that hath known man by lying with him.

units.leftText: But all the girls, who have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
units.rightText: But all the women-children, that have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.

units.leftText: “Encamp outside of the camp for seven days. Whoever has killed any person, and whoever has touched any slain, purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, you and your captives.
units.rightText: And encamp ye without the camp seven days: whosoever hath killed any person, and whosoever hath touched any slain, purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, ye and your captives.

units.leftText: You shall purify every garment, and all that is made of skin, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood.”
units.rightText: And as to every garment, and all that is made of skin, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood, ye shall purify yourselves.

units.leftText: Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who went to the battle, “This is the statute of the law which the LORD has commanded Moses.
units.rightText: And Eleazar the priest said unto the men of war that went to the battle, This is the statute of the law which Jehovah hath commanded Moses:

units.leftText: However the gold, and the silver, the bronze, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
units.rightText: howbeit the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,

units.leftText: everything that may withstand the fire, you shall make to go through the fire, and it shall be clean; nevertheless it shall be purified with the water for impurity. All that doesn’t withstand the fire you shall make to go through the water.
units.rightText: everything that may abide the fire, ye shall make to go through the fire, and it shall be clean; nevertheless it shall be purified with the water for impurity: and all that abideth not the fire ye shall make to go through the water.

units.leftText: You shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean. Afterward you shall come into the camp.”
units.rightText: And ye shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and ye shall be clean; and afterward ye shall come into the camp.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Count the plunder that was taken, both of man and of animal, you, and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the congregation;
units.rightText: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the congregation;

units.leftText: and divide the plunder into two parts: between the men skilled in war, who went out to battle, and all the congregation.
units.rightText: and divide the prey into two parts: between the men skilled in war, that went out to battle, and all the congregation.

units.leftText: Levy a tribute to the LORD of the men of war who went out to battle: one soul of five hundred; of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks.
units.rightText: And levy a tribute unto Jehovah of the men of war that went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, both of the persons, and of the oxen, and of the asses, and of the flocks:

units.leftText: Take it from their half, and give it to Eleazar the priest, for the LORD’s wave offering.
units.rightText: take it of their half, and give it unto Eleazar the priest, for Jehovah’s heave-offering.

units.leftText: Of the children of Israel’s half, you shall take one drawn out of every fifty, of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks, of all the livestock, and give them to the Levites, who perform the duty of the LORD’s tabernacle.”
units.rightText: And of the children of Israel’s half, thou shalt take one drawn out of every fifty, of the persons, of the oxen, of the asses, and of the flocks, even of all the cattle, and give them unto the Levites, that keep the charge of the tabernacle of Jehovah.

units.leftText: Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.
units.rightText: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as Jehovah commanded Moses.

units.leftText: Now the plunder, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep,
units.rightText: Now the prey, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,

units.leftText: seventy-two thousand head of cattle,
units.rightText: and threescore and twelve thousand oxen,

units.leftText: sixty-one thousand donkeys,
units.rightText: and threescore and one thousand asses,

units.leftText: and thirty-two thousand persons in all, of the women who had not known man by lying with him.
units.rightText: and thirty and two thousand persons in all, of the women that had not known man by lying with him.

units.leftText: The half, which was the portion of those who went out to war, was in number three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep;
units.rightText: And the half, which was the portion of them that went out to war, was in number three hundred thousand and thirty thousand and seven thousand and five hundred sheep:

units.leftText: and the LORD’s tribute of the sheep was six hundred seventy-five.
units.rightText: and Jehovah’s tribute of the sheep was six hundred and threescore and fifteen.

units.leftText: The cattle were thirty-six thousand, of which the LORD’s tribute was seventy-two.
units.rightText: And the oxen were thirty and six thousand; of which Jehovah’s tribute was threescore and twelve.

units.leftText: The donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred, of which the LORD’s tribute was sixty-one.
units.rightText: And the asses were thirty thousand and five hundred; of which Jehovah’s tribute was threescore and one.

units.leftText: The persons were sixteen thousand, of whom the LORD’s tribute was thirty-two persons.
units.rightText: And the persons were sixteen thousand; of whom Jehovah’s tribute was thirty and two persons.

units.leftText: Moses gave the tribute, which was the LORD’s wave offering, to Eleazar the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.
units.rightText: And Moses gave the tribute, which was Jehovah’s heave-offering, unto Eleazar the priest, as Jehovah commanded Moses.

units.leftText: Of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided off from the men who fought
units.rightText: And of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided off from the men that warred

units.leftText: (now the congregation’s half was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,
units.rightText: (now the congregation’s half was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand, seven thousand and five hundred sheep,

units.leftText: thirty-six thousand head of cattle,
units.rightText: and thirty and six thousand oxen,

units.leftText: thirty thousand five hundred donkeys,
units.rightText: and thirty thousand and five hundred asses,

units.leftText: and sixteen thousand persons),
units.rightText: and sixteen thousand persons),

units.leftText: even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one drawn out of every fifty, both of man and of animal, and gave them to the Levites, who performed the duty of the LORD’s tabernacle, as the LORD commanded Moses.
units.rightText: even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one drawn out of every fifty, both of man and of beast, and gave them unto the Levites, that kept the charge of the tabernacle of Jehovah; as Jehovah commanded Moses.

units.leftText: The officers who were over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came near to Moses.
units.rightText: And the officers that were over the thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came near unto Moses;

units.leftText: They said to Moses, “Your servants have taken the sum of the men of war who are under our command, and there lacks not one man of us.
units.rightText: and they said unto Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war that are under our charge, and there lacketh not one man of us.

units.leftText: We have brought the LORD’s offering, what every man found: gold ornaments, armlets, bracelets, signet rings, earrings, and necklaces, to make atonement for our souls before the LORD.”
units.rightText: And we have brought Jehovah’s oblation, what every man hath gotten, of jewels of gold, ankle-chains, and bracelets, signet-rings, ear-rings, and armlets, to make atonement for our souls before Jehovah.

units.leftText: Moses and Eleazar the priest took their gold, even all worked jewels.
units.rightText: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, even all wrought jewels.

units.leftText: All the gold of the wave offering that they offered up to the LORD, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels.
units.rightText: And all the gold of the heave-offering that they offered up to Jehovah, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.
leftNotes: 31:52 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces, so 16,750 shekels is about 167.5 kilograms or about 368.5 pounds.

units.leftText: The men of war had taken booty, every man for himself.
units.rightText: ( For the men of war had taken booty, every man for himself.)

units.leftText: Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the Tent of Meeting for a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD.
units.rightText: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tent of meeting, for a memorial for the children of Israel before Jehovah.

units.leftText: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of livestock. They saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead. Behold, the place was a place for livestock.
units.rightText: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place was a place for cattle;

units.leftText: Then the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the princes of the congregation, saying,
units.rightText: the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spake unto Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and unto the princes of the congregation, saying,

units.leftText: “Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,
units.rightText: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Sebam, and Nebo, and Beon,

units.leftText: the land which the LORD struck before the congregation of Israel, is a land for livestock; and your servants have livestock.”
units.rightText: the land which Jehovah smote before the congregation of Israel, is a land for cattle; and thy servants have cattle.

units.leftText: They said, “If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants for a possession. Don’t bring us over the Jordan.”
units.rightText: And they said, If we have found favor in thy sight, let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession; bring us not over the Jordan.

units.leftText: Moses said to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, “Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?
units.rightText: And Moses said unto the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to the war, and shall ye sit here?

units.leftText: Why do you discourage the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD has given them?
units.rightText: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which Jehovah hath given them?

units.leftText: Your fathers did so when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to see the land.
units.rightText: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to see the land.

units.leftText: For when they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them.
units.rightText: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which Jehovah had given them.

units.leftText: The LORD’s anger burned in that day, and he swore, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah’s anger was kindled in that day, and he sware, saying,

units.leftText: ‘Surely none of the men who came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me,
units.rightText: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:

units.leftText: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun, because they have followed the LORD completely.’
units.rightText: save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun; because they have wholly followed Jehovah.

units.leftText: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he made them wander back and forth in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation who had done evil in the LORD’s sight was consumed.
units.rightText: And Jehovah’s anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander to and fro in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of Jehovah, was consumed.

units.leftText: “Behold, you have risen up in your fathers’ place, an increase of sinful men, to increase the fierce anger of the LORD toward Israel.
units.rightText: And, behold, ye are risen up in your fathers’ stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of Jehovah toward Israel.

units.leftText: For if you turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and you will destroy all these people.”
units.rightText: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye will destroy all this people.

units.leftText: They came near to him, and said, “We will build sheepfolds here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones;
units.rightText: And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:

units.leftText: but we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel, until we have brought them to their place. Our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
units.rightText: but we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel, until we have brought them unto their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.

units.leftText: We will not return to our houses until the children of Israel have all received their inheritance.
units.rightText: We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.

units.leftText: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us on this side of the Jordan eastward.”
units.rightText: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan, and forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side of the Jordan eastward.

units.leftText: Moses said to them: “If you will do this thing, if you will arm yourselves to go before the LORD to the war,
units.rightText: And Moses said unto them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will arm yourselves to go before Jehovah to the war,

units.leftText: and every one of your armed men will pass over the Jordan before the LORD until he has driven out his enemies from before him,
units.rightText: and every armed man of you will pass over the Jordan before Jehovah, until he hath driven out his enemies from before him,

units.leftText: and the land is subdued before the LORD; then afterward you shall return, and be clear of obligation to the LORD and to Israel. Then this land shall be your possession before the LORD.
units.rightText: and the land is subdued before Jehovah; then afterward ye shall return, and be guiltless towards Jehovah, and towards Israel; and this land shall be unto you for a possession before Jehovah.

units.leftText: “But if you will not do so, behold, you have sinned against the LORD; and be sure your sin will find you out.
units.rightText: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against Jehovah; and be sure your sin will find you out.

units.leftText: Build cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which has proceeded out of your mouth.”
units.rightText: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.

units.leftText: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, “Your servants will do as my lord commands.
units.rightText: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.

units.leftText: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock shall be there in the cities of Gilead;
units.rightText: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead;

units.leftText: but your servants will pass over, every man who is armed for war, before the LORD to battle, as my lord says.”
units.rightText: but thy servants will pass over, every man that is armed for war, before Jehovah to battle, as my lord saith.

units.leftText: So Moses commanded concerning them to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers’ households of the tribes of the children of Israel.
units.rightText: So Moses gave charge concerning them to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel.

units.leftText: Moses said to them, “If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over the Jordan, every man who is armed to battle before the LORD, and the land is subdued before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession;
units.rightText: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over the Jordan, every man that is armed to battle, before Jehovah, and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:

units.leftText: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.”
units.rightText: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.

units.leftText: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, “As the LORD has said to your servants, so will we do.
units.rightText: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As Jehovah hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.

units.leftText: or with any stone, by which a man may die, not seeing him, and cast it on him so that he died, and he was not his enemy and not seeking his harm,
units.rightText: or with any stone, whereby a man may die, seeing him not, and cast it upon him, so that he died, and he was not his enemy, neither sought his harm;

units.leftText: then the congregation shall judge between the striker and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances.
units.rightText: then the congregation shall judge between the smiter and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances;

units.leftText: The congregation shall deliver the man slayer out of the hand of the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to his city of refuge, where he had fled. He shall dwell therein until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.
units.rightText: and the congregation shall deliver the manslayer out of the hand of the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to his city of refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall dwell therein until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.

units.leftText: “‘But if the man slayer shall at any time go beyond the border of his city of refuge where he flees,
units.rightText: But if the manslayer shall at any time go beyond the border of his city of refuge, whither he fleeth,

units.leftText: and the avenger of blood finds him outside of the border of his city of refuge, and the avenger of blood kills the man slayer, he shall not be guilty of blood,
units.rightText: and the avenger of blood find him without the border of his city of refuge, and the avenger of blood slay the manslayer; he shall not be guilty of blood,

units.leftText: because he should have remained in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest. But after the death of the high priest, the man slayer shall return into the land of his possession.
units.rightText: because he should have remained in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the manslayer shall return into the land of his possession.

units.leftText: “‘These things shall be for a statute and ordinance to you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
units.rightText: And these things shall be for a statute and ordinance unto you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

units.leftText: “‘Whoever kills any person, the murderer shall be slain based on the testimony of witnesses; but one witness shall not testify alone against any person so that he dies.
units.rightText: Whoso killeth any person, the murderer shall be slain at the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person that he die.

units.leftText: “‘Moreover you shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer who is guilty of death. He shall surely be put to death.
units.rightText: Moreover ye shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer, that is guilty of death; but he shall surely be put to death.

units.leftText: “‘You shall take no ransom for him who has fled to his city of refuge, that he may come again to dwell in the land before the death of the priest.
units.rightText: And ye shall take no ransom for him that is fled to his city of refuge, that he may come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.

units.leftText: “‘So you shall not pollute the land where you live; for blood pollutes the land. No atonement can be made for the land for the blood that is shed in it, but by the blood of him who shed it.
units.rightText: So ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye are: for blood, it polluteth the land; and no expiation can be made for the land for the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.

units.leftText: You shall not defile the land which you inhabit, where I dwell; for I, the LORD, dwell among the children of Israel.’”
units.rightText: And thou shalt not defile the land which ye inhabit, in the midst of which I dwell: for I, Jehovah, dwell in the midst of the children of Israel.

units.leftText: The heads of the fathers’ households of the family of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near and spoke before Moses and before the princes, the heads of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel.
units.rightText: And the heads of the fathers’ houses of the family of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spake before Moses, and before the princes, the heads of the fathers’ houses of the children of Israel:

units.leftText: They said, “The LORD commanded my lord to give the land for inheritance by lot to the children of Israel. My lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.
units.rightText: and they said, Jehovah commanded my lord to give the land for inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my lord was commanded by Jehovah to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters.

units.leftText: If they are married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of our fathers, and will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So it will be taken away from the lot of our inheritance.
units.rightText: And if they be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then will their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of our fathers, and will be added to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they shall belong: so will it be taken away from the lot of our inheritance.

units.leftText: When the jubilee of the children of Israel comes, then their inheritance will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.”
units.rightText: And when the jubilee of the children of Israel shall be, then will their inheritance be added unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they shall belong: so will their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.

units.leftText: Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the LORD’s word, saying, “The tribe of the sons of Joseph speak what is right.
units.rightText: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of Jehovah, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph speaketh right.

units.leftText: This is the thing which the LORD commands concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, ‘Let them be married to whom they think best, only they shall marry into the family of the tribe of their father.
units.rightText: This is the thing which Jehovah doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them be married to whom they think best; only into the family of the tribe of their father shall they be married.

units.leftText: So shall no inheritance of the children of Israel move from tribe to tribe; for the children of Israel shall all keep the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
units.rightText: So shall no inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe; for the children of Israel shall cleave every one to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

units.leftText: Every daughter who possesses an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel shall be wife to one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may each possess the inheritance of his fathers.
units.rightText: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel, shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may possess every man the inheritance of his fathers.

units.leftText: So shall no inheritance move from one tribe to another tribe; for the tribes of the children of Israel shall each keep his own inheritance.’”
units.rightText: So shall no inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe; for the tribes of the children of Israel shall cleave every one to his own inheritance.

units.leftText: The daughters of Zelophehad did as the LORD commanded Moses:
units.rightText: Even as Jehovah commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad:

units.leftText: for Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to their father’s brothers’ sons.
units.rightText: for Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their father’s brothers’ sons.

units.leftText: They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph. Their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.
units.rightText: They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph; and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.

units.leftText: These are the commandments and the ordinances which the LORD commanded by Moses to the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
units.rightText: These are the commandments and the ordinances which Jehovah commanded by Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
